anua-3-ceramide-panthenol-moisture-barri.bottom: A fragrance-free ceramide cream made for sensitive skin. It is gentle and calming where other basic creams failed. Bumps or irritation turned up in some cases.

yes.title: Gentle where others failed
yes.t: ==Settled in on skin that reacted to CeraVe, Vanicream or La Roche-Posay creams==.

yes.title: Soothing, hydrating
yes.t: Feels ==soothing and hydrating on normal-to-dry, easily irritated skin== over weeks of use.

no.title: Bumps or irritation for a few
no.t: ==Deep bumps, closed comedones or sore eyes== showed up for a few after regular use.

anua-azelaic-acid-10-hyaluron-redness-so.bottom: A light, fragrance-free azelaic serum with hyaluronic acid, gentle on sensitive and dry skin. It eases breakouts and redness for some. Others break out, and it feels tacky.

yes.title: Gentle on sensitive skin
yes.t: Mostly painless, even on ==dry or barrier-damaged skin== and layered under a moisturizer.

yes.title: Helps quiet breakouts
yes.t: Bumps and whiteheads ==look calmer after about 4 to 8 weeks== of daily use on oily skin.

yes.title: Light, watery texture
yes.t: Thin and ==fast to absorb, so it layers easily== in a morning or night routine.

yes.title: Tones down mild redness
yes.t: Cheeks and nose look ==a little calmer after a few weeks==, not overnight.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: ==Whiteheads and cystic bumps== appear for some, sometimes within the first weeks.

no.title: Slow on marks and redness
no.t: Dark marks and stubborn redness ==may not budge even after months==.

no.title: Tacky, can pill
no.t: Leaves ==a sticky finish that can ball up under moisturizer==, mostly on oily skin.

no.title: Stings or reddens some
no.t: A few get ==tingling, itching or redness== on starting, sensitive faces included.

anua-heartleaf-77-soothing-toner.bottom: A fragrance-free, watery toner for layering light hydration in a big bottle. It suits normal and dry skin that wants calm. It stings or breaks some people out.

yes.title: Watery and easy to layer
yes.t: A runny toner you ==pat on in thin layers==, absorbing fast with no sticky film.

yes.title: Calming after harsh steps
yes.t: Feels ==cool and calming after over-exfoliating or drying treatments==, for many.

yes.title: A big bottle goes far
yes.t: ==A large bottle that lasts months== of twice-daily use.

no.title: Stings or burns some skin
no.t: ==Stings or burns on first use for some skin==, and has left a few red or itchy.

no.title: Small bumps for some
no.t: ==Small closed bumps appear on some faces== within weeks.

no.title: More exfoliating than soothing
no.t: Reads ==mildly exfoliating, so daily use is too much== for some skin.

no.title: Nothing noticeable for some
no.t: ==No visible difference at all== beyond a damp, fresh feel, even after a few months.

anua-heartleaf-pore-control-cleansing-oi.bottom: A lightly scented heartleaf cleansing oil that lifts sunscreen, makeup and nose gunk quickly. The big catch is that it breaks many faces out in closed bumps, sometimes for months.

yes.title: Lifts makeup and sunscreen
yes.t: Massaged in dry, then emulsified, ==it melts off sunscreen and stubborn mascara==.

yes.title: Pores look cleaner
yes.t: Nose and T-zone ==look clearer and smoother right after a cleanse==, without a greasy film.

yes.title: Fine for some oily skin
yes.t: A minority of oily, breakout-prone faces ==use it for years without trouble==.

no.title: Breaks many faces out
no.t: Closed comedones and cystic spots follow ==within days to a few weeks== and can linger after stopping.

tip.t: Keep it for makeup or sunscreen days, not every day.

no.title: Texture lingers after stopping
no.t: Skin can turn ==rough or bumpy once the effect fades==, and the texture can last for months.

no.title: Dries or irritates some skin
no.t: Dryness, redness or itch show up for some, ==mostly on sensitive or dry skin==.

anua-heartleaf-quercetinol-pore-deep-cle.bottom: A fragrance-free foaming cleanser that leaves skin soft for some and dries out others. It suits oily skin best.

yes.title: Foams well, leaves skin soft
yes.t: Foams nicely and leaves skin ==soft and smooth without a tight feel== for some.

no.title: Can dry out skin
no.t: ==Dry patches and tightness== after several days on combination and dehydrated skin.

anua-niacinamide-10-txa-4-serum.bottom: A fragrance-free niacinamide and tranexamic acid serum for dark marks, with a watery feel. A few get burning or itching, and some see no change in marks.

yes.title: Marks look lighter
yes.t: Dark marks from breakouts ==look lighter over a few weeks== of daily use, often used on spots.

yes.title: Hydrated, dewy glow
yes.t: Despite the watery feel, it ==leaves skin hydrated with a dewy glow== that layers under makeup.

yes.title: Daily use suits many
yes.t: Many sensitive and breakout-prone faces ==stay calm== through months of once-a-day use.

no.title: Burns or itches for some
no.t: ==Burning and itching show up for some==, mostly dry or sensitive skin.

no.title: Marks may not change
no.t: ==Some see no change in dark or red marks== after weeks of twice-daily use.

no.title: Foam and tack when rubbed in
no.t: ==Foams white briefly when rubbed in== and a tacky layer looks oily to some.

anua-rice-70-glow-milky-toner.bottom: A fragrance-free, watery rice toner that is calming and absorbs quickly. It breaks out some faces and gives only light hydration.

yes.title: Thin, calming and quick
yes.t: A ==thin, watery fluid that absorbs quickly== and leaves skin calm without film.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: ==Clogged pores and chin breakouts== for some, though others see calmer skin.

no.title: Light on hydration
no.t: ==Minimal extra hydration== and no glass-skin glow, and it can sting on pimples.

aveeno-calm-restore-nourishing-oat-clean.bottom: A fragrance-free, non-foaming oat gel cleanser that is very gentle and leaves skin soft. It suits sensitive, dry and combination skin on a small budget. It won't shift sunscreen or makeup, and a few faces sting or break out.

yes.title: Very gentle, never stripping
yes.t: ==Comfortable even on a damaged barrier==, or after a harsh wash irritated skin.

yes.title: Soft, not tight, after rinsing
yes.t: Doesn't foam, but ==feels more like a moisturizer than a wash== on dry skin.

yes.title: Suits sensitive and dry skin
yes.t: ==Reactive and dry faces tolerate it for months to years==, with no breakouts for most.

yes.title: Cheap to keep using
yes.t: The ==big refill pouch lasts ages==, and it replaces pricier cleansers.

no.title: Too mild for sunscreen or makeup
no.t: ==Needs a follow-up cleanse== at night after sunscreen or makeup; it suits mornings alone.

tip.t: Cleanse with an oil or balm first, then use this as the second step.

no.title: Can leave a film
no.t: Can ==need a second wash on oily skin==, and the film fades with time for some.

no.title: Stings some faces
no.t: ==Burning or redness starts at the first use== for some, often near the eyes.

no.title: Splits opinion on breakouts
no.t: Some see ==smoother texture within weeks==, others get closed comedones or bumps.

aveeno-calm-restore-oat-gel-moisturizer.bottom: A fragrance-free oat gel cream, light and cooling, best for normal to oily skin in warm weather. Dry skin outgrows it fast, and it can pill under sunscreen.

yes.title: Light, cooling, not greasy
yes.t: A cool gel cream that ==sinks in without a greasy or sticky film==.

yes.title: Hydrates for a light gel
yes.t: ==Hydrating enough for most mornings==, especially in summer and on normal to oily skin.

yes.title: Fine on oily, breakout-prone skin
yes.t: Stays ==light rather than heavy or tacky on oily skin==, even by day.

yes.title: Soothing on touchy skin
yes.t: Redness looks ==calmer within a couple of weeks== on skin that flushes easily.

no.title: Pills under sunscreen
no.t: Can ==roll into flakes under sunscreen, makeup or retinoids==, unless the layer is very thin.

tip.t: Use a thin layer and give it a few minutes to sink in before sunscreen.

no.title: Too light for dry skin
no.t: ==Dry skin and cold winters need something richer==; the gel fades within hours.

no.title: Itches or stings some skin
no.t: Some faces ==itch, sting or feel warm right after it goes on==.

no.title: Odd smell in some jars
no.t: Fragrance-free, yet ==some jars smell plasticky or like pencil shavings==.

aveeno-calm-restore-triple-oat-serum.bottom: A fragrance-free glycerin and oat serum that adds soft hydration and calm to dry, sensitive skin. It is simple rather than powerful. It flares or stings some reactive skin.

yes.title: Light glycerin hydration
yes.t: Leaves skin ==soft and hydrated without heaviness==, and sits well under moisturizer or makeup.

yes.title: Calms redness
yes.t: ==Tones down redness and soothes== skin that is reacting, though not instantly.

yes.title: Layers easily
yes.t: A few drops ==go under or mixed into your moisturizer== and soften retinoid-dried skin.

no.title: Can sting or flare up
no.t: ==Bumps, stinging or flare-ups== hit some sensitive skin, and it burns on a broken barrier.

no.title: Soothing only, no actives
no.t: Soothing and hydrating, ==with no actives to change texture or tone==.

no.title: Awkward dropper
no.t: The dropper ==makes small doses fiddly== to dispense.

aveeno-positively-radiant-daily-moisturi.bottom: A scented SPF 30 moisturizer with a light glow that disappoints more than it pleases. Irritation, oiliness and pilling come up most.

yes.title: Fine for some skins
yes.t: ==Didn't cause breakouts for some==, and it is fairly priced for a daily SPF.

no.title: Dries out and irritates
no.t: ==Dry patches, redness and itch== appear for some after switching to it.

no.title: Greasy and pills
no.t: Can ==look shiny and pill under other products==.

avene-cicalfate-restorative-protective-c.bottom: A thick, fragrance-free barrier cream with a copper-zinc complex, for irritated and reactive skin. It's a go-to night step over retinoids. It clogs some faces and feels heavy.

yes.title: Takes the sting out of actives
yes.t: Settles ==burning and stinging from overdone retinol or acids== at night.

yes.title: Calms visible redness
yes.t: Redness ==settles with nightly use==, on the cheeks and around the mouth.

yes.title: Soothes a damaged barrier
yes.t: Reached for when skin is raw: ==softens peeling and tight, angry patches==.

yes.title: Handy for spot repair
yes.t: ==Works after shaving, laser or a facial== and as a spot dab on irritation.

no.title: Can clog pores
no.t: Breaks some people out, ==mostly with constant use after skin has healed==.

tip.t: Keep it for flares and recovery nights, not every day.

no.title: Thick and greasy
no.t: A ==slick, occlusive balm feel== that sits on top and stays tacky.

no.title: Can dry or itch
no.t: Can leave dry skin ==flaky and itchy==, and a few get itchy reactions.

no.title: Better for flares than daily
no.t: Fits ==recovery weeks better than everyday wear==, once skin has healed.

avene-retrinal-0-1-intensive-cream.bottom: A fragrance-free retinaldehyde night cream that is easier on skin than tretinoin. It can still flush or peel, and results are slow.

yes.title: Easier than tretinoin
yes.t: A retinal that ==suits skin that couldn't handle tretinoin==, with little or no irritation.

yes.title: Smoother, softer lines
yes.t: Skin looks ==smoother and fine lines softer after a few weeks== of steady nightly use.

no.title: Can still flush or peel
no.t: Too frequent use ==caused flushing and peeling== for some, who dropped to a lower strength.

no.title: Slow or no visible change
no.t: ==Slow to show results== for some, and the price makes that hard to accept.

avene-thermal-spring-water.bottom: A fragrance-free spring water mist that cools and calms skin and can be used over or under makeup. It suits sensitive skin. It has no actives, so it feels pricey for plain water.

yes.title: Calms hot, irritated skin
yes.t: A fine spray ==settles the stinging, itching or flushed feel== within minutes.

yes.title: Cool, refreshing mid-day lift
yes.t: A cooling spritz that ==freshens skin and tight, freshly cleansed faces== during the day.

yes.title: Preps skin, softens makeup
yes.t: Misted before serum or cream, it ==helps them go on smoother== and softens powdery makeup.

yes.title: Fine, travel-friendly mist
yes.t: An even fine mist, ==extra cooling from the fridge==, in can sizes made for bags.

no.title: Pricey for plain water
no.t: ==Plain spring water with no active ingredients==, so some skin sees nothing extra for the price.

no.title: Doesn't replace a moisturizer
no.t: ==Hydration is brief==, so dry skin still needs a serum or cream on top.

tip.t: Mist, then follow straight away with serum or cream.

no.title: Calming effect can be mild
no.t: On some faces ==the calming effect is only moderate==, and dehydrated skin can feel drier.

avene-tolerance-control-soothing-skin-re.bottom: A thick, fragrance-free cream for very reactive and dry-leaning skin that feels raw from actives. It is rich enough to suit night best, and a few faces find it itchy or clogging.

yes.title: Soothes raw, reactive skin
yes.t: Rarely stings on ==raw, over-exfoliated skin==, and redness looks calmer.

yes.title: Cushions retinoid nights
yes.t: A ==comfortable layer over tretinoin and other actives== that doesn't add redness.

yes.title: Rich but not greasy
yes.t: Thick in the jar, yet ==non-greasy with a matte finish once rubbed in==.

no.title: Itches or stings some skin
no.t: A few faces ==itch, tingle or sting for minutes== after it goes on.

no.title: Thick, slow to rub in
no.t: ==Takes effort to rub in== and feels heavy by day, so it suits night better.

no.title: Clogs a few faces
no.t: Some skin gets ==closed bumps, especially on the forehead==.

avene-tolerance-extremely-gentle-cleanse.bottom: A fragrance-free cleansing lotion made for dry, sensitive skin, used wiped off or rinsed. It cleans without leaving skin tight. It can leave a film, and it's a light cleanse for heavy makeup.

yes.title: Gentle, leaves skin soft
yes.t: Cleans ==without stripping, so skin feels soft after rinsing==, unlike foaming cleansers.

yes.title: Hydrating on dry skin
yes.t: Dehydrated skin ==feels more comfortable within days== of switching to it.

yes.title: Fine for reactive skin
yes.t: ==Works for very reactive faces== that flared with other cleansers.

yes.title: Wipe off or rinse
yes.t: Use it ==tissued off, rinsed, or as a second cleanse== after a balm.

no.title: Can leave a film
no.t: Leaves ==a sticky or milky residue== that pills under sunscreen and makeup.

tip.t: Rinse it off with water instead of tissuing it off.

no.title: Irritates or breaks out a few
no.t: Can bring ==whiteheads, redness or dryness== on thin, red-prone or clog-prone skin.

no.title: A light cleanse only
no.t: ==Heavy makeup or oil needs a stronger first cleanse==; on its own it can feel unfinished.

axis-y-complete-no-stress-physical-sunsc.bottom: A fragrance-free mineral sunscreen with niacinamide that fades to a light cast. It suits sensitive skin, but the thick feel and herbal smell are not for everyone.

yes.title: Little white cast
yes.t: Goes on pale but ==fades to a minimal cast within 5 to 15 minutes==; may show more on deep tones.

yes.title: Gentle on sensitive skin
yes.t: ==No chemical filters==, so it suits skin that reacts to them.

no.title: Heavy, can pill under makeup
no.t: Feels ==thick and greasy in heat and humidity==, and can pill under makeup.

no.title: Noticeable herbal smell
no.t: Has a ==strong earthy mugwort smell== that lingers for some.

axis-y-dark-spot-correcting-glow-serum.bottom: A light, quick-absorbing niacinamide gel serum aimed at dark marks. It evens tone slowly and works better on fresh marks than old ones. It breaks some people out and offers little moisture.

yes.title: Lightweight and quick to sink in
yes.t: A thin gel that ==absorbs fast and layers without pilling==, with no greasy film.

yes.title: Eases fresh breakout marks
yes.t: Newer marks ==look lighter after a month or two==, while older spots barely move.

yes.title: Mild for most skin
yes.t: Stings less than stronger niacinamide serums and ==stays comfortable on many sensitive faces==.

yes.title: Brighter-looking tone
yes.t: Overall tone looks ==a little brighter and smoother== within weeks, even where spots hold on.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: Brings ==small pimples or cysts for some==, often from week two or on niacinamide-intolerant skin.

tip.t: Ease in on spots or every other day before using it all over.

no.title: Old spots barely change
no.t: Stubborn or older dark spots ==show little change even after several tubes==.

no.title: Can itch or sting for some
no.t: ==Itches or irritates on first use== for some, especially skin that doesn't agree with niacinamide.

no.title: Little moisture on its own
no.t: The gel's ==hydration fades quickly==, so dry skin needs a moisturizer on top.

axis-y-quinoa-one-step-balanced-gel-clea.bottom: A light gel cleanser with quinoa and essential oils that lathers well and rinses clean. It suits oily and sensitive skin as a daily wash. It is unremarkable on dry or breakout-prone skin.

yes.title: Cleans without stripping
yes.t: Lathers, rinses clean and ==leaves skin comfortable, not squeaky==, even when sensitive.

yes.title: Light, lasts a long time
yes.t: A ==thin, almost liquid gel that lasts about a year== on daily use.

no.title: Nothing special for some
no.t: ==Fine but unremarkable== on normal-to-dry and on oily, breakout-prone skin.

no.title: Not for heavy makeup
no.t: Can ==struggle to lift waterproof makeup== on its own.

axis-y-spot-the-difference-blemish-treat.bottom: A fragrance-free tea tree spot gel that is gentle for spot treatments. It dries individual blemishes. It does little for scars or stubborn acne.

yes.title: Gentle, not drying
yes.t: Calms spots ==without the flaking of typical spot treatments==, even on dry skin.

yes.title: Small blemishes fade
yes.t: Whiteheads and ==small pimples fade over days to weeks==.

no.title: Little on scars or deep spots
no.t: ==Marks and deep pimples barely changed==.

beauty-of-joseon-apricot-blossom-peeling.bottom: A fragrance-free peeling gel that lifts dry flakes gently. It suits sensitive and combination skin used once or twice a week. Effects are subtle.

yes.title: Gentle for sensitive skin
yes.t: Rolls off flakes ==without stinging or drying==, even on sensitive or dry skin.

yes.title: Smooth, soft finish
yes.t: Skin ==feels smoother and softer, which helps foundation go on evenly==.

no.title: Subtle effect
no.t: Gentle enough that ==some notice little change and prefer a chemical exfoliant==.

no.title: Keep it occasional
no.t: ==Over-using it can irritate==, so a minute or less once or twice a week.

beauty-of-joseon-calming-barrier-serum-g.bottom: A watery, fragrance-free green tea and panthenol serum that's light, fast-absorbing and gentle. It adds hydration and calms redness for many; it can be too mild.

yes.title: Gentle on reactive skin
yes.t: ==Sits comfortably alongside tretinoin== on very reactive skin.

yes.title: Tones down redness
yes.t: Redness looks ==calmer within a few weeks== of daily use, not overnight.

no.title: Too mild for some skin
no.t: Can be ==only hydrating, with no calming effect== on irritated skin.

no.title: Needs steady use
no.t: ==Takes several weeks of regular use== before any calming shows.

beauty-of-joseon-day-dew-sunscreen.bottom: A fragrance-free SPF 50 with a dewy, moisturizer-like feel. Comfortable on dry skin, but it can sting the eyes when you sweat.

yes.title: Dewy and moisturizing
yes.t: Leaves dry skin ==plump with a glow==, and can replace moisturizer.

no.title: Stings eyes when sweaty
no.t: Melts into the eyes ==when you sweat==, at the gym or in the sun.

no.title: US version less liked
no.t: The US version ==smells like sunscreen and uses filters some dislike==.

beauty-of-joseon-dynasty-cream.bottom: A fragrance-free gel cream with squalane and niacinamide, made for normal to dry skin. It hydrates well through the night. The tacky finish can pill under sunscreen, and oily skin finds it heavy.

yes.title: Hydrates through the night
yes.t: Skin wakes up ==plump and soft after an overnight layer==, even in dry climates.

yes.title: Soothing on dry, reactive skin
yes.t: Retinoid-dry and easily flushed skin ==feels comfortable and calm== under a thin layer.

yes.title: Glassy, dewy finish
yes.t: Leaves a ==glossy, dewy finish== that gives foundation a smooth base.

yes.title: Good value for a full cream
yes.t: ==A big tube lasts a long while== with daily use.

no.title: Tacky, pills over sunscreen
no.t: Stays ==sticky for a while and pills under sunscreen or makeup== unless tapped in thinly.

tip.t: Use a small amount and tap it in rather than rubbing.

no.title: Heavy on oily skin
no.t: ==Reads heavy and shiny on oily and combination skin==, most of all in humid weather.

no.title: Splits on breakout-prone skin
no.t: ==Calm for some, clogged pores for others==: closed comedones and bumps show up on some faces.

no.title: A few notice a floral scent
no.t: Listed fragrance-free, yet ==a few smell a floral note and sting on reactive days==.

beauty-of-joseon-ginseng-cleansing-oil.bottom: A scented cleansing oil with a middle-weight texture that melts makeup and rinses clean. It suits dry and sensitive skin. It breaks some people out, and the herbal scent is not for everyone.

yes.title: Gentle for a cleansing oil
yes.t: Rinses off ==without stinging or stripping==, including around the eyes.

yes.title: Rinses clean, lifts makeup
yes.t: Turns milky with water and ==leaves no greasy film==, so rinsing is easy.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: ==Brings on breakouts for some==, including bumps and clogged pores within a week.

no.title: Herbal scent divides
no.t: A ==ginseng-herbal scent that smells odd to some==, enough that one switched.

beauty-of-joseon-ginseng-essence-water.bottom: A fragrance-free, watery essence with ginseng and niacinamide, patted on as a first step. It adds light, soothing hydration for dry, combination and reactive skin. The effect is mild, and some see nothing.

yes.title: Light, soothing layer
yes.t: Absorbs fast and ==leaves skin soft and refreshed== when patted in before moisturiser.

yes.title: Comfortable on reactive skin
yes.t: Easily flushed skin ==stays calm and comfortable==, even where other toners caused reactions.

yes.title: A soft glow
yes.t: Brings a ==gentle glow the next day== with regular use; skin looks duller when skipped.

yes.title: Lasts a while
yes.t: A plain, dependable toner; ==one bottle lasts for months==.

no.title: Little effect for some
no.t: ==No visible change for some even after months==, beyond slight hydration.

no.title: Too light for dry skin
no.t: Hydration stays mild, so ==dry skin needs a cream or second toner on top==.

no.title: Reacts badly on a few
no.t: ==Redness, sticky feel or breakouts== appear on a few faces from the first use.

no.title: Feels greasy on some
no.t: ==Sits sticky or oily after patting in== on some skin, within an hour.

beauty-of-joseon-glow-deep-serum-rice-al.bottom: A fragrance-free, watery alpha-arbutin serum aimed at dark marks and dullness. Results are slow and uneven.

yes.title: Marks fade gradually
yes.t: Dark marks and post-breakout spots ==look lighter from about four weeks== of daily use.

yes.title: Watery and quick to absorb
yes.t: A thin, runny serum that ==soaks in almost at once== without stickiness for many.

yes.title: Soothing next to strong actives
yes.t: Fragrance-free and ==mild enough to pair with azelaic acid or retinal==.

yes.title: Subtle glow under makeup
yes.t: Leaves ==a soft glow that stays visible under makeup==.

no.title: No change for some
no.t: Marks and sunspots ==stay put for some== even after a full bottle.

no.title: Breaks a few people out
no.t: Comedones and whiteheads ==turned up for a few==, sometimes after a month of calm use.

no.title: Tacky or shiny on some faces
no.t: It can feel ==slightly tacky or shiny== on some oily or combination skin.

no.title: Short-lived hydration
no.t: On very dry skin the moisture ==fades quickly==, so a cream is still needed.

beauty-of-joseon-glow-replenishing-rice-.bottom: A fragrance-free, watery milky toner that gives light hydration. It is runny and the glow doesn't last, so it's not a must-have.

yes.title: Light, quick hydration
yes.t: A ==watery toner that sinks in fast== and adds soft moisture without stickiness.

no.title: Runny, easy to over-pour
no.t: Thinner than a milky toner suggests, so ==it is easy to pour too much==.

no.title: Glow doesn't last
no.t: ==The glow fades quickly== and finishes matte, and it isn't as rich as other milky toners.

beauty-of-joseon-glow-serum-propolis-nia.bottom: A fragrance-free propolis and niacinamide serum that gives a dewy glow and gentle hydration. It suits dry and reactive skin; results are subtle, and it breaks some people out.

yes.title: Dewy glow and hydration
yes.t: Leaves ==a glassy, comfortable finish== that sits well under sunscreen and makeup.

yes.title: Soothing on reactive skin
yes.t: ==Calms stinging and redness== on sensitive skin, without a stripped feeling.

yes.title: Softens marks over weeks
yes.t: Post-pimple marks and tone ==look softer after a month or two==, not overnight.

yes.title: Fair price for propolis
yes.t: ==Reasonably priced for a propolis serum==, and a little covers face and neck.

no.title: Subtle for many
no.t: Bottles often finish with ==no visible change beyond hydration and a glow==.

no.title: Splits opinion on breakouts
no.t: ==Settles pimples on some faces, but clogged pores and spots show within days on others==.

no.title: Tacky before it settles
no.t: Sticky for a few minutes, and ==tacky for good on some skin==.

no.title: Fiddly dropper, small bottle
no.t: A hard-to-control dropper and ==a small bottle that runs out quickly== with daily use.

beauty-of-joseon-green-plum-refreshing-c.bottom: A fragrance-free, light gel cleanser that foams softly and rinses clean without tightness. It suits sensitive and combination skin as a morning wash or second cleanse. It's a weak makeup remover, and dry skin may feel stripped.

yes.title: Non-stripping clean
yes.t: Skin feels ==soft and untouched after rinsing==, with no tight or squeaky feeling.

yes.title: Good second cleanse
yes.t: Lifts leftover oil or sunscreen ==after an oil or balm== without drying.

yes.title: Light morning wash
yes.t: A ==fresh jelly gel that needs only a little to lather== and rinses easily.

no.title: Weak on makeup
no.t: ==Needs a remover first for heavy or waterproof makeup==, and avoid the eye area.

no.title: Drying for some
no.t: ==Turns dry or rashy in winter== on some dry, sensitive or combination skin.

no.title: Light clean for some
no.t: ==Can cleanse too lightly for some==, leaving oily or clog-prone faces congested.

beauty-of-joseon-green-plum-refreshing-t.bottom: A fragrance-free toner that exfoliates mildly with AHA and BHA. It suits oily and combination skin as a daily step. Dry or very reactive skin may find it too much.

yes.title: Mild daily exfoliation
yes.t: Used every morning or night, it ==exfoliates without the dryness or flaking== stronger acids bring.

yes.title: Smoother texture over months
yes.t: Skin looks ==smoother and acne marks look fainter after months of use==, not days.

no.title: Irritates some skin
no.t: ==Stinging, itching or tiny bumps== showed up on dry, sensitive and dehydrated skin.

tip.t: Use it alone: stinging came with layering and with evening use.

beauty-of-joseon-ground-rice-and-honey-g.bottom: A fragrance-free wash-off rice and honey mask with a light grit. It leaves skin soft, smooth and glowy. The scent is earthy and a few faces stung.

yes.title: Soft, glowy finish
yes.t: Skin feels ==hydrated, smooth and glowing straight after rinsing==.

yes.title: Gentle, non-drying
yes.t: The honey ==doesn't dry skin even on oily or sensitive faces==.

no.title: Earthy scent
no.t: Smells ==natural and earthy==, which not everyone likes.

beauty-of-joseon-light-on-serum-centella.bottom: A light, fragrance-free vitamin C serum with centella. Some skin finds it mild and soothing. It has also burned and reddened a number of faces, so patch test first.

yes.title: Mild for some skin
yes.t: A soft, light serum that ==feels soothing on dry and sensitive skin==.

yes.title: Gentle brightening
yes.t: Brightens ==slightly and evenly rather than dramatically==, with a light texture.

no.title: Can burn or redden
no.t: ==Can burn and leave skin red or lumpy==, sometimes after a single use.

tip.t: Patch test before putting it on your whole face.

no.title: Breakouts for some
no.t: Felt ==thick, pilled and clogged pores== on oily, breakout-prone faces.

beauty-of-joseon-matte-sun-stick-mugwort.bottom: A fragrance-free SPF 50+ stick with a dry, matte finish, best for oily skin and midday top-ups. It can pill in heat, feel waxy, and takes several passes to cover.

yes.title: Mattifies oily skin
yes.t: Leaves a ==dry, matte finish that tones down shine== on oily and combination skin.

yes.title: Quick midday top-ups
yes.t: A small stick that makes ==midday reapplication quick== at the beach, gym or desk.

yes.title: Little white cast
yes.t: Looks ==nearly clear and thin== on most skin, never heavy.

yes.title: Kind to touchy eyes and skin
yes.t: A ==gentler pick for sunscreen-reactive skin==, with fewer red, watery eyes.

no.title: Pills in heat and humidity
no.t: Can ==ball up on skin in hot, humid weather==, and sometimes in winter over moisturizer.

no.title: Waxy, tacky feel
no.t: Feels ==waxy or tacky once you sweat==, and picks up fuzz and hair.

no.title: Patchy, thin coverage
no.t: Takes several passes to cover evenly, so ==full-face coverage is hard to judge==.

no.title: Can dry or flake
no.t: Clings to dry patches and ==can leave skin flaky or dry== for some.

beauty-of-joseon-radiance-cleansing-balm.bottom: A fragrance-free cleansing balm that melts sunscreen and everyday makeup without leaving a film. It suits most skin types, but heavy or waterproof makeup can need a second cleanse and it can sting eyes.

yes.title: Melts makeup and sunscreen
yes.t: Sunscreen and everyday makeup ==melt away in seconds and rinse off without residue==.

yes.title: Gentle on reactive skin
yes.t: Didn't clog or irritate ==combination, sensitive or breakout-prone skin== for most.

yes.title: Leaves skin soft, not tight
yes.t: Rinses to ==smooth skin with no tightness or oily film==, even as a dry skin's only cleanse.

yes.title: One tub goes far
yes.t: A ==large tub at a low price== that lasts months, even used nightly.

no.title: Stubborn makeup may need two passes
no.t: ==Waterproof or stubborn makeup can need a second cleanse==, though some lift it in one pass.

no.title: Can sting or blur eyes
no.t: Brief ==stinging or blurred vision== is possible when it runs toward the lash line.

no.title: Firm, waxy texture
no.t: ==Crumbles when scooped on cold days== and can turn to oil before it emulsifies.

beauty-of-joseon-red-bean-refreshing-por.bottom: A fragrance-free red bean and kaolin clay mask for a weekly pore tidy-up. It rinses clean without the tight feel of most clay masks. It does little for stubborn blackheads and breaks a few people out.

yes.title: Clay mask that doesn't dry out
yes.t: Washes off ==without the tight, dried-out feel== of most clay masks, even on dry skin.

yes.title: Soft, smooth skin after rinsing
yes.t: Skin looks ==smoother and softer straight after rinsing==, with pores looking a little tighter.

yes.title: Cooling, comfortable to use
yes.t: Goes on as a ==creamy, cooling layer== with light exfoliation from the bean granules.

yes.title: Plenty of product for the price
yes.t: The jar is ==large for the price==, and a thin layer once a week stretches it.

no.title: Little for stubborn blackheads
no.t: Only light exfoliation, so ==stubborn blackheads and closed bumps barely change==.

no.title: Breaks a few people out
no.t: Can leave ==small pimples after the first uses== on blemish-prone skin.

no.title: Can irritate stressed skin
no.t: Grains feel scratchy to some, and it ==turned red and flaky on skin already irritated==.

no.title: Glow fades within days
no.t: Smoothness and plumpness ==last about two days==, so it's an optional extra.

beauty-of-joseon-red-bean-water-gel.bottom: A fragrance-free, ultra-light gel moisturizer for oily and combination skin, best in hot, humid weather. It is thin alone, and some clog-prone skin gets closed bumps.

yes.title: Featherlight gel
yes.t: Sinks in at once with ==no sticky or greasy feel==, even in hot weather.

yes.title: Suits oily and combo skin
yes.t: A morning moisturizer for oily skin that ==dries to a soft matte finish==.

no.title: Closed bumps for some
no.t: Closed bumps ==built up within weeks== for some, including combination skin.

no.title: Thin on its own
no.t: Dehydrated or combination skin ==needs a richer cream on top==.

beauty-of-joseon-relief-sun-aqua-fresh-r.bottom: A fragrance-free, watery SPF 50+ that feels weightless with little shine and no white cast. It suits oily and combination skin; it pills on some and clogs a few.

yes.title: Weightless, non-greasy feel
yes.t: A watery fluid that ==disappears on skin and never turns greasy==, even in humid heat.

yes.title: Less shine than the original
yes.t: Dries to ==a soft-matte, natural finish== that reads less shiny than the original.

yes.title: No white cast
yes.t: Blends in ==invisibly on medium skin and under foundation== with no visible cast.

yes.title: Less dewy under foundation
yes.t: Sits ==matte under dewy foundations== when applied thin and left to set.

no.title: Pills over other layers
no.t: ==Rolls into little balls== over other products or even bare skin on a lot of faces.

tip.t: Let each layer set, then pat it on gently rather than rubbing it in.

no.title: Can clog pores
no.t: ==Gives some people closed comedones== or breakouts, though many stay clear.

no.title: Can sting tender skin
no.t: Can ==burn on damp or tender skin==, and sting if it reaches the eyes.

no.title: Too light for dry skin
no.t: ==Needs a moisturizer underneath==; dry skin can feel tight and sheds the layer.

beauty-of-joseon-relief-sun-rice-probiot.bottom: A fragrance-free SPF 50+ that wears like a light moisturizer, with a dewy finish and little white cast. It suits dry and normal skin best; on oily skin it turns shiny and clogs some pores.

yes.title: Feels like a moisturizer
yes.t: A light lotion that ==can stand in for your morning moisturizer== on normal to dry skin.

yes.title: Little white cast
yes.t: Blends in on most skin tones; ==a faint tint can show on deeper skin== before it settles.

yes.title: Easy on sensitive skin
yes.t: No fragrance, and ==comfortable on most sensitive, dry skin==.

yes.title: Sits well under makeup
yes.t: ==Works smoothly under makeup==, with little pilling.

no.title: Clogs some pores
no.t: Leaves ==small closed bumps on some oily, clog-prone skin==.

no.title: Shiny on oily skin
no.t: Oily skin ==looks greasy by midday==, worst in heat or with extra layers.

alt.t: The lighter Aqua-Fresh version, if you're oily or clog easily.

no.title: Can sting near the eyes
no.t: It ==can burn if it gets into the eyes==, or on a face dried by retinoids.

no.title: Not sweat-resistant
no.t: ==Not made for sweat or water==, so reapply after a workout.

beauty-of-joseon-revive-eye-serum-ginsen.bottom: A light, fragrance-free retinal serum with ginseng, used around the eyes or over the whole face. It's a mild way into retinal. It irritates some eyes, and results come slowly.

yes.title: Gentle way into retinal
yes.t: A low-strength retinal that ==most ease into with no irritation==, on the eyes or the whole face.

yes.title: Light and fast absorbing
yes.t: A watery gel-cream that ==soaks in quickly and never feels heavy==, with next-morning plumpness.

yes.title: Softens fine lines slowly
yes.t: ==Lines look softer after about 1 to 4 months== of steady use, not overnight.

yes.title: Milia bumps fade
yes.t: Small bumps around the eyes ==look flatter within days to weeks== for some.

no.title: Can irritate the eyes
no.t: Some get ==gritty, itchy or swollen eyes==, mostly when it reaches the lash line.

tip.t: Keep it off the lash line and eyelids if your eyes react.

no.title: Dry, patchy skin around eyes
no.t: In the first weeks some see ==tightness or patchy dryness==, which can linger.

no.title: Slow, subtle results
no.t: Dark circles and lines ==often barely change==, and it's mild next to stronger retinoids.

bioderma-hydrabio-serum.bottom: A scented hydrating serum with hyaluronic acid and niacinamide, thicker than most. It suits dry and reactive skin. Oilier skin can find it tacky.

yes.title: Hydrates through the night
yes.t: ==Skin stays plump and moisturized until morning==, including damaged or dry skin.

yes.title: Keeps makeup smooth
yes.t: Mixed into foundation, it ==stops makeup separating on very dry skin==.

no.title: Thick for oily skin
no.t: ==A heavier, tacky feel that can tingle on oilier skin==, especially under a moisturizer.

no.title: Pricey, used sparingly
no.t: A ==small bottle that people stretch out==, with a silicone feel.

bioderma-sebium-h2o-micellar-water.bottom: A scented micellar water for oily and combination skin that removes makeup without stinging. Fragrance is noticeable, and it broke one person out.

yes.title: Makeup comes off, no sting
yes.t: Removes makeup ==without stinging the eyes==, and works as a first or second cleanse.

yes.title: Shine tones down for hours
yes.t: Leaves the oily T-zone ==less shiny for a few hours== without drying it.

no.title: Scent and slight stickiness
no.t: Has a ==noticeable herbal scent== that fades, and can feel a bit sticky.

bioderma-sensibio-h2o-micellar-water.bottom: A fragrance-free micellar water that lifts makeup and most sunscreen with no rinse. Gentle on sensitive skin, but it costs more than Garnier and waterproof formulas need extra passes.

yes.title: Gentle on sensitive skin
yes.t: ==Little redness or stinging==, even on very reactive skin wiped with cotton pads.

yes.title: Easy on the eyes
yes.t: Takes off eye makeup ==without the sting== some drugstore micellar waters cause.

yes.title: Lifts makeup and sunscreen
yes.t: Wipes away ==everyday makeup and most sunscreen== with no scrubbing.

yes.title: Good first cleanse
yes.t: A ==quick first cleanse before a gentle wash==, or a no-fuss swipe on tired nights.

no.title: Waterproof needs extra work
no.t: ==Waterproof mascara and mineral or tinted sunscreen need extra passes== or an oil cleanser.

tip.t: Use it as a first cleanse, then follow with a gentle wash.

no.title: Pricey next to Garnier
no.t: Costs ==well above Garnier, with similar removal== for many.

no.title: Stings or breaks out some
no.t: Can ==bring small bumps or a sting== on some reactive skin.

no.title: Can leave skin tight
no.t: Some skin ==feels tight afterwards==, especially if the cleanser is left on.

tip.t: Rinse with water afterwards and follow with moisturizer.

byoma-creamy-jelly-cleanser.bottom: A fragrance-free jelly cleanser with ceramides that lathers lightly and rinses off easily. Kind to dry and sensitive skin, but it stings the eyes for some.

yes.title: Cleans without stripping
yes.t: Lathers into a soft cream that ==clears light makeup and rinses off clean==, never squeaky.

yes.title: Settles reactive skin
yes.t: Skin that reacts to other cleansers ==looks calmer around the nose and cheeks==.

no.title: Stings the eyes for some
no.t: Can ==burn the eyes==, and for one person it stung the whole face at first.

no.title: Not right for every face
no.t: Feels ==too mild on oily skin==, and a bit drying or breakout-causing for a few.

byoma-milky-toner.bottom: A fragrance-free, ceramide milky toner that adds light, quick hydration after cleansing. It suits dry and sensitive skin. A minority react with burning, redness or breakouts.

yes.title: Deep, light hydration
yes.t: Thin and milky, ==it hydrates deeply without a sticky or slippery film==.

yes.title: Calms dry, reactive skin
yes.t: ==Soothes and plumps tight, reactive skin== and keeps it comfortable for months.

yes.title: Eases dryness from strong actives
yes.t: A good rescue ==when skin is dry and dull from strong skin-drying treatments==.

yes.title: Soft glow, little product
yes.t: A small amount gives ==a soft glow under sunscreen or foundation==.

no.title: Burns or reddens some skin
no.t: ==Burning or redness appears within days== on some dry or reactive skin.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: ==Whiteheads and breakouts show up on some breakout-prone skin==, and settle after stopping.

no.title: Too thin for dry winter skin
no.t: ==Too light on its own for dry or winter skin==, so a cream goes on top.

byoma-moisturizing-gel-cream.bottom: A light, fragrance-free gel cream with niacinamide and green tea, best in warm weather. It suits oily and combination skin. The catch: dry skin outgrows it, and it tingles on some sensitive faces.

yes.title: Light, no shine
yes.t: Two pumps cover the face, ==hydrating without grease or shine==.

yes.title: Keeps combination skin balanced
yes.t: ==T-zone oil stays in check while cheeks stay moisturized==, even beside a retinol.

yes.title: Kind to a damaged barrier
yes.t: Goes on ==without burning skin that other basic creams stung==.

no.title: Too light for dry skin
no.t: ==Not enough in cold weather or on dry skin==; it needs a richer cream.

no.title: Tingles on some skin
no.t: ==Tingling or redness== in the first week on some sensitive skin.

no.title: Breaks a few faces out
no.t: ==Pimples show up on a few faces== that had used it happily for months.

cerave-acne-control-gel.bottom: A fragrance-free salicylic acid gel with AHAs that keeps breakouts and blackheads in check slowly. Start slowly, and the effect fades when you stop.

yes.title: Calmer breakouts, clearer pores
yes.t: ==Breakouts and blackheads look calmer over weeks==, steady rather than overnight.

yes.title: Light, cooling gel
yes.t: A ==clear, cooling gel that spreads evenly== and absorbs quickly.

no.title: Easy to overdo
no.t: Nightly use from the start ==brought a purge-like flare== for some.

tip.t: Start once or twice a week and apply after cleansing.

no.title: Needs ongoing use
no.t: ==Breakouts return after a break==, and the effect can wane over time.

cerave-acne-foaming-cream-cleanser.bottom: A fragrance-free 4% benzoyl peroxide cream cleanser that foams and dries less than most. It suits oily, combination and breakout-prone skin. It bleaches towels, and it can feel harsh on some skin.

yes.title: Keeps breakouts down
yes.t: Used once or twice daily, ==pimples look fewer and settle faster after a few weeks==.

yes.title: Gentler benzoyl peroxide
yes.t: ==Less drying than leave-on gels or PanOxyl==, as a wash that is rinsed off.

yes.title: Fits active routines
yes.t: Often ==used with tretinoin or Differin== without extra dryness.

no.title: Stains towels and clothes
no.t: ==Bleaches towels and fabric==, even when rinsed carefully.

no.title: Can dry or sting
no.t: Can ==burn or dry the nose and eye area==, mostly with twice-daily use.

tip.t: Cut back to every other day if skin gets dry.

no.title: Less help for deeper spots
no.t: ==Deeper, stubborn spots stay== for some, while milder ones fade.

cerave-am-facial-moisturizing-lotion-wit.bottom: A fragrance-free SPF 30 lotion with ceramides that stands in for a separate morning moisturizer. It suits normal to combination skin that doesn't mind a slight sheen. It pills for many, so smooth it in slowly.

yes.title: Moisturizer and SPF in one
yes.t: ==Replaces a separate morning moisturizer== and sunscreen, lightweight and quick to soak in for some.

yes.title: Hydration for normal to dry skin
yes.t: Ceramides and hyaluronic acid ==keep normal to mildly dry skin comfortable== through the day.

yes.title: Affordable everyday SPF
yes.t: ==A budget-friendly pick== compared with pricier moisturizers with sunscreen.

no.title: Pills under serums and makeup
no.t: ==Balls up and flakes== over serums, moisturizer or makeup, sometimes even on bare skin.

tip.t: Smooth a small area at a time and let it set before makeup.

alt.t: The lighter CeraVe SPF 30 lotion pills less and soaks in better.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: Brings new bumps on some faces, ==sometimes by the end of the day==.

no.title: Shiny or white on some skin
no.t: Can look ==greasy and shiny by noon== on oily skin, or leave a white cast when rubbed in.

no.title: Too light for very dry skin
no.t: Very dry skin ==still feels thirsty after layering== it and needs a richer cream first.

cerave-daily-moisturizing-lotion.bottom: A light, fragrance-free pump lotion with ceramides and hyaluronic acid, easy on face and body. It suits normal to combination skin. The catch: it breaks some faces out and stings others.

yes.title: Light, non-greasy finish
yes.t: Absorbs fast and ==sits under makeup and sunscreen without pilling==, good in warm weather.

yes.title: Keeps normal to dry skin soft
yes.t: ==Comfortable hydration through the day== on normal to dry skin, with the cream for very dry spells.

yes.title: One bottle for face and body
yes.t: The pump ==covers face, hands and body==, handy for frequently washed skin.

yes.title: Costs less than CeraVe PM
yes.t: Does ==much the same job as the PM lotion for less==.

no.title: Breaks many people out
no.t: ==Closed comedones and forehead bumps== show up within weeks for a good share of faces.

no.title: Stings or reddens some skin
no.t: ==Burning or redness== shows up for some, especially after exfoliating or on a damaged barrier.

no.title: Too light for very dry skin
no.t: Very dry skin or ==winter needs the cream or an oil on top==.

alt.t: The CeraVe cream, which is richer for very dry skin and cold weather.

no.title: Odd smell from some bottles
no.t: ==Some bottles smell fishy or chemical== straight from the pump.

cerave-eye-repair-cream.bottom: A fragrance-free eye cream in a squeeze tube, light but moisturizing. It suits dry under-eyes and sits well under concealer. It does little for dark circles and irritates some eyes.

yes.title: Hydrates dry under-eyes
yes.t: Keeps drier-than-face under-eyes and lids ==soft and comfortable through the day==.

yes.title: Sits well under concealer
yes.t: Sinks in fast, ==prepping skin for concealer without caking== for most.

yes.title: Fine lines look smoother
yes.t: Fine lines look ==a little plumper after a couple of weeks==, mostly from added moisture.

yes.title: Easy, cheap tube
yes.t: A hygienic squeeze tube at a drugstore price, so ==it is a low-risk basic to try==.

no.title: Little for dark circles
no.t: ==Little visible change even after a month or more== of daily use; it moisturizes and not much else.

no.title: Stings some eyes
no.t: Burns or itches for some, ==sometimes after weeks of fine use or alongside a retinoid==.

no.title: Can cause under-eye bumps
no.t: Small pimples can appear ==after just a few uses, even on skin that rarely breaks out==.

no.title: Light for very dry lids
no.t: ==Too light for very dry eyelids== or a full night's moisture.

tip.t: Use a richer cream at night and keep this for daytime under makeup.

cerave-foaming-facial-cleanser.bottom: A fragrance-free gel cleanser for normal to oily skin, inexpensive and long-lasting. It dries out some skin and breaks others out, so judge it over a few weeks. Dry and reactive skin often does better with a creamier wash.

yes.title: Cleans without squeaky tightness
yes.t: Lifts oil and makeup ==without the tight feel on oily and combination skin==, for most.

yes.title: Tolerated by many sensitive faces
yes.t: A fragrance-free gel that ==stays calm on many reactive faces== and works for some breakout-prone skin.

yes.title: Cheap and lasts for months
yes.t: A big pump bottle ==lasts a long time==, which keeps the daily cost low.

no.title: Dries out some skin
no.t: Leaves ==skin tight, flaky or squeaky for some==, mostly in winter, on dry skin or on retinoids.

tip.t: Use a pea-sized amount, or swap to the Hydrating cleanser in winter.

alt.t: The Hydrating Cleanser, a softer wash for dry or winter skin.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: Brings ==small bumps and closed comedones== for some, sometimes after years of use.

no.title: Can sting or turn peely
no.t: On reactive skin it ==burns, itches or peels== for a few.

no.title: Needs two rounds for makeup
no.t: Rinses slowly and ==can leave a film==, so heavy makeup needs a second wash.

cerave-healing-ointment.bottom: A fragrance-free ointment with ceramides, made to seal in moisture as the last step at night. It rescues dry, flaky and retinoid-dried skin; a thin layer is enough. Clog-prone skin should start small.

yes.title: Seals in moisture overnight
yes.t: Over your moisturizer at night, it ==leaves dry, flaky skin soft by morning==.

yes.title: Calms retinoid dryness
yes.t: A thin layer over tretinoin or retinol ==settles the flaking and peeling==.

yes.title: Kind to reactive skin
yes.t: No fragrance or lanolin, and ==easy on very reactive, barrier-damaged skin==.

yes.title: Spreads easier than Vaseline
yes.t: ==Thinner and smoother than Vaseline or Aquaphor==, so a little goes far.

no.title: Greasy, marks the pillow
no.t: Stays ==shiny and greasy for hours== and rubs off on pillowcases.

no.title: Can clog pores
no.t: Breaks some people out, ==mostly with thick layers or on hot nights==.

tip.t: Start with a rice-grain amount; thinner layers clog less.

no.title: Not the heaviest seal
no.t: For very dry, cracked skin, ==Aquaphor seals more, for longer==.

cerave-hydrating-cream-to-foam-cleanser.bottom: A fragrance-free ceramide cleanser with a creamy, light foam that rinses off without a squeaky feel. It suits dry to combination skin and lifts sunscreen. It dries or irritates a fair few faces.

yes.title: Cleans without stripping
yes.t: Leaves skin ==soft and comfortable rather than tight==, even in a twice-daily routine.

yes.title: Lifts sunscreen and makeup
yes.t: Takes off ==sunscreen and everyday makeup in one or two washes==; waterproof mascara is harder.

yes.title: Works for combination skin
yes.t: ==Lathers enough for oilier skin== without the stripped feel of CeraVe's foaming cleanser.

yes.title: Fine with active routines
yes.t: Often ==used alongside retinoids and other actives== without extra irritation.

no.title: Dries some skin
no.t: ==Leaves some cheeks tight, flaky or dehydrated==, mostly on dry or reactive skin.

tip.t: Use it as a second cleanse or a few times a week.

alt.t: The non-foaming CeraVe Hydrating cleanser, for very dry skin.

no.title: Splits on breakouts
no.t: ==Some faces stay clearer and others break out== after switching to it.

no.title: Stings or reddens
no.t: Can ==sting or leave redness==, especially around the eyes and nose.

no.title: Leaves a film
no.t: Some bottles ==leave a residue that is slow to rinse off==.

cerave-hydrating-facial-cleanser.bottom: A fragrance-free, lotion-textured cleanser with ceramides, made for normal to dry and reactive skin. It cleans without stripping but lifts little makeup or sunscreen. Breakout-prone skin should go slowly.

yes.title: No tight, squeaky feel
yes.t: Foaming washes leave skin tight; this ==rinses off creamy and comfortable== instead.

yes.title: Easy on dry, reactive skin
yes.t: Dry and easily irritated skin stays ==soft and calm, even through cold winters==.

yes.title: A soft second cleanse
yes.t: Works well ==as the second step after an oil or balm cleanse== in a nightly double cleanse.

yes.title: Cheap, with no scent
yes.t: A ==low price and a big bottle==, with no added fragrance.

no.title: Barely removes makeup
no.t: ==Leaves mascara, sunscreen and makeup behind==, so it needs a first cleanse on makeup days.

tip.t: Use it as the second cleanse after an oil or balm cleanser.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: Closed bumps and whiteheads ==show up for some within days, for others after months==.

no.title: Can leave a film
no.t: A ==thin lotion film that feels heavy to some==, mostly on oily and combination skin.

no.title: Stings some skin
no.t: Can sting or flush for some, ==mostly right after a peel or alongside strong actives==.

cerave-hydrating-hyaluronic-acid-serum.bottom: A fragrance-free hyaluronic serum with ceramides in a thick gel-cream texture. It suits dry skin. It pills under layers and some bottles arrive watery.

yes.title: Hydrating gel-cream
yes.t: A ==thick, comfortable gel-cream== that leaves dry skin plumper within a week or two.

yes.title: Layers with a routine
yes.t: ==Sits well under a CeraVe moisturizer== at night and with retinoids.

no.title: Pills under layers
no.t: ==Rolls into small balls== under sunscreen, makeup or moisturizer.

no.title: Inconsistent bottles
no.t: Some bottles arrive ==watery with white chunks== or smell off.

cerave-moisturizing-cream.bottom: A thick, fragrance-free ceramide cream in a big, cheap tub, a staple for dry skin. It softens retinoid dryness too. The catch is the face: it breaks some people out and runs heavy on oily skin.

yes.title: Keeps dry skin comfortable
yes.t: A thick cream that ==keeps very dry skin moisturized== through winter and overnight.

yes.title: Softens retinoid dryness
yes.t: Over tretinoin or retinol it ==keeps flaking and tightness in check==.

yes.title: Plain formula for reactive skin
yes.t: ==Fragrance-free and plain==, so it suits very reactive skin and a stressed barrier.

yes.title: Big tub, small price
yes.t: ==A large tub that lasts for months== and beats pricier creams for some.

no.title: Breaks some faces out
no.t: Gives some people ==closed comedones and small bumps== on the face.

tip.t: Use a small amount on damp skin; too much feels heavy.

alt.t: Vanicream, for faces that break out from this tub.

no.title: Heavy on oily skin
no.t: Feels ==thick and greasy within an hour== on oily or combination skin.

no.title: Can sting a damaged barrier
no.t: ==Burns on compromised skin== or when stacked with strong actives.

no.title: Waxy on the face
no.t: Often ==feels waxy or sticky on the face== even when it suits the body.

cerave-pm-facial-moisturizing-lotion.bottom: A fragrance-free niacinamide and ceramide lotion with a light, gel-like feel that sinks in fast. It suits normal, combination and many sensitive faces. It breaks some people out and stings others.

yes.title: Light gel-lotion feel
yes.t: Silky and watery, so ==it sinks in within a minute== and layers under serums or sunscreen.

yes.title: Hydrates without weight
yes.t: Moisture that ==lasts through the day for normal to dry skin==, with no heavy film.

yes.title: Easy on sensitive skin
yes.t: ==No fragrance, and soothing on many reactive faces== after over-exfoliating or a flare.

yes.title: Wears well by day
yes.t: Light enough that ==it sits smoothly under sunscreen and makeup==; some use it morning and night.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: ==Closed comedones and cystic bumps== show up for some within days, even where other CeraVe lotions are fine.

no.title: Stings some skin
no.t: ==A burn on application== shows up, more often over vitamin C, BHA or a damaged barrier.

no.title: Too light for very dry skin
no.t: On very dry skin ==moisture fades within hours== and needs a richer layer.

tip.t: Layer a thicker cream over it on very dry nights.

cerave-renewing-sa-cleanser.bottom: A fragrance-free salicylic acid gel cleanser for normal to oily, breakout-prone skin. It suits blackheads and small bumps, but dryness is common and it breaks some people out.

yes.title: Eases blackheads and small bumps
yes.t: Left on for a minute or two, ==pores look clearer and bumps flatter== by around week three.

yes.title: Mild for some skin
yes.t: Used once a day at night, it can ==lather and rinse without a tight or squeaky feel==.

yes.title: Lifts sunscreen and excess oil
yes.t: ==Takes off sunscreen, light makeup and surface oil== in one wash; heavy makeup needs a first cleanse.

yes.title: Big bottle, low cost
yes.t: A large bottle ==lasts for months==, so it works out cheap per wash.

no.title: Dries and tightens skin
no.t: Many skins feel ==tight and dry within days==, most of all dry, sensitive or retinol-using skin.

tip.t: Use it a few nights a week and moisturize straight after rinsing.

alt.t: The plainer CeraVe Hydrating cleanser for dry or reactive days.

no.title: Splits opinion on breakouts
no.t: ==Clears blackheads and bumps on some faces but brings tiny bumps or cysts on others==.

no.title: Can sting reactive skin
no.t: Reddening or burning shows up ==mostly on reactive skin or when it sits on too long==.

no.title: Residue and smell quirks
no.t: A white film can be left behind, and ==bottles kept in a damp shower can turn smelly==.

cerave-resurfacing-retinol-serum.bottom: A fragrance-free, encapsulated retinol serum that works as a mild first step into retinoids. It's light and gentle for most. Gentle also means too weak for some, and it breaks others out.

yes.title: Gentle way into retinol
yes.t: A mild starter with ==little burning, peeling or dryness==, even on reactive skin.

yes.title: Light, easy to layer
yes.t: A ==light, fast-absorbing gel-cream== that sits easily under moisturizer.

yes.title: Calms some breakouts
yes.t: Bumps look calmer ==after a few months of steady use== for some.

yes.title: Evens leftover marks
yes.t: Dark marks ==look lighter after a month or more==, though stubborn ones stay.

no.title: Purge or new breakouts
no.t: ==A purge can run for months== or bring fresh breakouts, oily skin included.

tip.t: Start twice a week over moisturizer and build up slowly.

no.title: Too mild for some
no.t: ==Too gentle to show much change== for some, who move on to stronger retinoids.

no.title: Still irritates some skin
no.t: Can leave skin ==dry, flaky or stinging==, especially around the eyes.

cerave-skin-renewing-night-cream.bottom: A fragrance-free ceramide night cream in a small tub, thick and creamy rather than greasy. It suits dry skin and retinoid dryness best at night. It breaks some faces out and stings a few.

yes.title: Rich overnight moisture
yes.t: A thick, creamy layer that ==leaves dry skin soft and supple by morning== without a greasy feel.

yes.title: Settles retinoid dryness
yes.t: Layered under tretinoin or adapalene, ==it keeps skin comfortable and cuts the flaking==.

yes.title: Soothing on reactive skin
yes.t: Fragrance-free, and ==comfortable on stressed, barrier-damaged skin== for most.

no.title: Can clog and break out
no.t: Some faces get whiteheads or closed bumps, ==often within a couple of weeks==.

alt.t: The lighter PM lotion in a pump suited faces that broke out on this cream.

no.title: Heavy and waxy
no.t: Thick and slow to spread, so ==it is kept for night only== and is too much for some even then.

no.title: Stings for some
no.t: Burns or stings on some skin, ==often under adapalene or when niacinamide doesn't agree==.

no.title: Scoop tub is awkward
no.t: Scooping is sticky, and ==the small tub runs out fast== with nightly use.

cerave-skin-renewing-vitamin-c-serum.bottom: A fragrance-free 10% vitamin C serum with hyaluronic acid and ceramides, gentle by vitamin C standards. It oxidizes fast, turning orange, and can pill under sunscreen.

yes.title: Easy first vitamin C
yes.t: ==Sensitive skin often handles it with no stinging==, even used daily for months.

yes.title: Evens tone and dark spots
yes.t: Dark spots and uneven tone ==look lighter after a month or two==.

yes.title: Light and hydrating
yes.t: Absorbs quickly with ==no greasy residue and a soft, hydrated feel==.

yes.title: Budget-friendly pick
yes.t: A ==more affordable pick== next to pricier vitamin C serums.

no.title: Oxidizes quickly
no.t: Darkens to orange and ==can tint skin patchy==, sometimes within weeks of opening.

tip.t: Keep it in the fridge to slow the colour change.

no.title: Pills under sunscreen
no.t: Moisturizer and sunscreen ==ball up on top== and feel greasy in the morning.

no.title: Irritates some skin
no.t: Redness or tiny bumps ==showed up for some, mostly in the first weeks==.

no.title: Fiddly packaging
no.t: The tube needs piercing and ==can leak or spoil as it runs low==.

cerave-ultra-light-moisturizing-lotion-s.bottom: A fragrance-free SPF 30 lotion that sinks in fast with no white cast, built for normal to oily skin. It dries to a soft matte finish under makeup. It breaks out a few people, and SPF 30 is modest.

yes.title: Very light, absorbs fast
yes.t: A thin lotion that ==soaks in almost instantly and adds no oil==, even on oily skin.

yes.title: No white cast
yes.t: Blends away ==on light and deeper skin tones alike==, with no ashy residue.

yes.title: Great under makeup
yes.t: ==Foundation sits smoothly on top==, with little pilling or breakdown.

yes.title: Soft matte finish
yes.t: May look shiny at first, then ==dries down to a soft matte within minutes==.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: ==Cystic bumps show up for a few== within days of starting.

no.title: Only SPF 30
no.t: ==Less protection than an SPF 50== for long summer days and beach trips.

no.title: Greasy for some
no.t: On some oily skin it ==goes on shiny and feels rich==, despite the name.

cetaphil-daily-facial-cleanser.bottom: A scented, gentle cleanser with niacinamide, popular on oily and combination skin. It cleans without stripping. The scent and the thinner feel of newer bottles put some people off.

yes.title: Gentle, non-stripping
yes.t: Cleans oil and makeup ==without leaving skin tight or dry==.

yes.title: Reliable for reactive skin
yes.t: A staple that ==stayed kind to reactive skin for years==.

no.title: Has a noticeable scent
no.t: It contains fragrance, and ==the smell is off-putting to some==.

no.title: Film, misses makeup
no.t: Can ==leave a film and miss makeup or sunscreen==; it dries out some skin.

cetaphil-gentle-skin-cleanser.bottom: A fragrance-free, low-foam lotion cleanser for dry, sensitive and normal skin. It suits a gentle morning wash. It removes little makeup or sunscreen, and it irritates or breaks out some skin.

yes.title: Gentle, doesn't strip
yes.t: Rinses off without the tight, squeaky feel, ==even on dry or reactive skin==.

yes.title: Easy beside strong actives
yes.t: ==Rarely adds dryness next to retinoids or acne treatments==, so flaking skin often stays comfortable.

yes.title: Kind to breakout-prone skin
yes.t: ==Doesn't dry out or add oil on breakout-prone skin==, and some faces look clearer on it.

yes.title: Wipe-off or second wash
yes.t: Used ==without rinsing, or as the second cleanse after an oil==, it stays comfortable.

no.title: Weak makeup remover
no.t: ==Waterproof makeup and sunscreen often stay behind==, even after a second pass.

tip.t: Take makeup off with an oil or micellar water first, then use this as the second wash.

no.title: Stings or reddens some skin
no.t: ==Burning, redness and itching hit some faces==, including skin that handled it for years.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: Small hard whiteheads and ==clogged pores appear on some faces==, sometimes within days to weeks.

no.title: Leaves a film for some
no.t: On some skin it ==rinses off slowly and leaves a sticky film==, so rinse for longer.

cetaphil-hydrating-eye-gel-cream.bottom: A lightweight eye gel-cream with a light scent. Fine for basic moisture, but it doesn't change dark circles for most.

yes.title: Light, hydrating moisture
yes.t: Absorbs easily and ==doesn't interfere with makeup==, plus feels soft on dry skin.

no.title: Dark circles mostly stay
no.t: Hereditary dark circles ==look much the same==, with the odd exception.

no.title: Burns when skin is irritated
no.t: Eyelids can ==burn when skin is already dried out by strong acne treatments==.

cetaphil-moisturizing-cream.bottom: A thick, fragrance-free cream for dry to very dry skin, face and body. It holds moisture through dry winters. It feels heavy on oily skin, and stings or breaks out a few people.

yes.title: Rich moisture for dry skin
yes.t: A thick cream that ==keeps very dry skin soft through the day== and across winter.

yes.title: Gentle on sensitive skin
yes.t: Fragrance-free and ==easy to wear alongside retinoids or benzoyl peroxide==, with little irritation.

yes.title: Works as the final sealing step
yes.t: Layered over hyaluronic acid or another cream, ==it seals moisture in overnight==.

yes.title: Big tubs, easy to find
yes.t: Comes in sizes from ==travel tube to a large tub==, so it's easy to restock.

no.title: Heavy and greasy on some skin
no.t: Too thick for oily skin, and ==it can sit on top rather than sink in==.

no.title: Stings some people
no.t: Can sting at first, ==especially around the eyes or after other actives==.

no.title: Breaks a few people out
no.t: A few skins ==get small breakouts or pilling under makeup==.

no.title: Too basic for some
no.t: Hydrates ==without much extra==, so some add a serum or want richer results.

cosrx-acne-pimple-master-patch.bottom: A cheap hydrocolloid spot patch that flattens open or picked pimples overnight and stops picking. It does little on closed pimples. Grip and speed vary from one person to the next.

yes.title: Flattens open pimples overnight
yes.t: On popped or surfaced spots it ==soaks up fluid and flattens them overnight==.

yes.title: Sticks well all night
yes.t: Grips well and ==usually stays on until morning==.

yes.title: Stops picking, kind to skin
yes.t: A seal that ==stops picking== and doesn't irritate dry or reactive skin.

yes.title: Helps big, stubborn spots
yes.t: Large blemishes ==look flatter and smaller by morning==, sometimes after a second night.

no.title: Needs an open spot
no.t: Mostly ==works on open or popped spots==, not closed ones.

no.title: Did little for some
no.t: ==Did little for some==, who found Nexcare or a generic hydrocolloid better.

no.title: Thick and noticeable
no.t: Not invisible: ==shows on the skin== and can lift at the edges.

cosrx-advanced-snail-92-all-in-one-cream.bottom: A fragrance-free snail mucin gel cream that hydrates lightly and calms skin. It suits oily, combination and normal skin best, especially in warm or humid weather. Dry skin usually needs a richer cream on top, and it breaks some people out.

yes.title: Light gel, sinks in fast
yes.t: Soaks in ==without a greasy film==, so it layers under sunscreen and makeup.

yes.title: Enough for oily and combo skin
yes.t: Works as ==the only moisturizer in summer or humid weather==, with no heavy feel.

yes.title: Soothes irritated skin
yes.t: ==Takes the edge off redness and tightness== while on tretinoin or after peels.

yes.title: Often fine on breakout-prone skin
yes.t: Many breakout-prone and reactive faces ==stay clear over months of daily use==.

no.title: Not enough for dry skin
no.t: ==Feels tight again within hours== unless a richer cream goes on top.

tip.t: Apply it to damp skin and seal it under a thicker cream.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: ==Painful bumps can appear within days==, even though it suits other breakout-prone skin.

no.title: Gooey, sticky texture
no.t: The ==stringy, slimy feel== is messy from a jar and stays tacky until it dries.

no.title: Irritates some faces
no.t: ==Tenderness, peeling or itch can appear a week in== on some faces.

cosrx-advanced-snail-96-mucin-power-esse.bottom: A fragrance-free snail mucin essence with a gooey, light-gel feel, used after toner. It suits dry, dehydrated and easily upset skin best. The catch is that it breaks some faces out.

yes.title: Hydrates dry, dehydrated skin
yes.t: Two or three thin layers under a cream leave ==skin soft and plumped through the day==.

yes.title: Calms upset skin
yes.t: A go-to after exfoliants or retinoids: ==it tones down redness and tightness==, and it rarely stings.

yes.title: Sinks in and layers well
yes.t: Tacky at first, then ==it sits well under sunscreen and makeup== and helps later layers absorb.

yes.title: A bottle lasts a long time
yes.t: Two or three pumps cover the face, so ==one bottle lasts for months==.

no.title: Breaks some faces out
no.t: Closed comedones can follow within days, ==even for those who love how soothing it is==.

tip.t: Apply it on damp skin right after toner, then seal with a moisturizer.

alt.t: The 92 cream is the one that sat better on faces that broke out on the essence.

no.title: Stings some skin
no.t: Burning or itching shows up for a few, ==sometimes only on a new bottle or over strong actives==.

no.title: Needs a cream on top
no.t: Light on its own: ==very dry skin wants a cream or oil sealed over it== to stay hydrated.

no.title: Sticky and can pill
no.t: Tacky until it sinks in, and ==it pills under sunscreen for some== if layered heavily.

cosrx-advanced-snail-peptide-eye-cream.bottom: A fragrance-free, lightweight snail mucin eye gel-cream that hydrates and sits well under concealer. It rarely changes dark circles.

yes.title: Hydrates the under-eyes
yes.t: Under-eyes look ==more hydrated and smooth within a few weeks==, without drying out.

yes.title: Rarely stings
yes.t: ==Neither stings nor irritates== for most sensitive eyes, even after other creams burned.

yes.title: Sits under concealer
yes.t: A light gel-cream that ==sinks in fast and doesn't move concealer== or lash extensions.

no.title: Dark circles and lines stay
no.t: Dark circles and fine lines ==look much the same after one to three months==.

no.title: Milia or stinging later
no.t: A few faces ==developed tiny bumps or a late sting== after liking it at first.

no.title: Thin for very dry lids
no.t: Reads thin and watery, with ==too little cushion for very dry lids==.

cosrx-aha-7-whitehead-power-liquid.bottom: A fragrance-free 7% glycolic acid liquid for clogged pores and rough texture, used a few nights a week. It stings or flakes many faces and has a sharp smell. Ease in once a week and build up slowly.

yes.title: Closed bumps look flatter
yes.t: Closed bumps and clogged pores ==look flatter after a few weeks== of slow, regular use.

yes.title: Smoother, brighter skin
yes.t: Skin turns ==smoother and glowier over weeks==, and tone looks more even.

yes.title: Eased in, it can be tolerable
yes.t: ==Building from weekly to daily use over several weeks== avoided most irritation.

no.title: Stings or flakes many faces
no.t: ==Stings, flushes or flakes== on a good share of skin, even with sparing use.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: Brings ==itchy whiteheads and pimples== on some faces, even at once a week.

no.title: Sharp, sweaty smell
no.t: A ==sharp, sweaty smell== comes through even though no fragrance is added.

no.title: Gains can plateau or fade
no.t: ==Early gains can plateau or fade== within a few weeks.

cosrx-aha-bha-clarifying-treatment-toner.bottom: A fragrance-free exfoliating toner with a low acid level, sprayed or swept on after cleansing. It smooths texture and eases oil for some. Others see no change, and a few get irritation or bumps.

yes.title: Smoother texture, tidier pores
yes.t: Skin ==feels smoother within a few uses== and pores can look less obvious.

yes.title: Less oil, smaller bumps
yes.t: Oily skin shows less surface oil, and ==small bumps fade over weeks to months of use==.

yes.title: Mild on resilient skin
yes.t: ==Gentle enough to layer before other actives== on skin already used to retinoids.

yes.title: Easy to apply
yes.t: An ==even spray mist== means no cotton pads are needed.

no.title: Irritates some skin
no.t: ==Stinging, redness or a stripped, tight feel== on skin not used to acids.

tip.t: Use it about twice a week rather than nightly.

no.title: Bumps and breakouts
no.t: ==Small bumps, whiteheads or pimples== showed up within weeks for a few.

no.title: Weak for an exfoliant
no.t: The acid level is low, so ==some see no change after weeks==.

cosrx-aloe-soothing-sun-cream-spf-50.bottom: A scented SPF 50 cream with aloe that feels like a moisturizer, best on dry skin and in cold weather. It pills for some and can feel heavy on oily skin. The fragrance is strong.

yes.title: Moisturizing like a cream
yes.t: Hydrating enough that ==many skip a separate moisturizer==, especially in winter.

yes.title: Little white cast
yes.t: Looks chalky at first but ==blends out on most skin tones==, light and deep.

yes.title: Kind to eyes and skin
yes.t: ==Doesn't sting the eyes for most==, and many reactive faces tolerate it daily.

yes.title: Sits well under makeup
yes.t: Leaves ==a smooth base for makeup== once it settles, with a soft finish.

no.title: Strong added fragrance
no.t: Has ==a heavy floral scent that lingers== and bothers some, including sensitive noses.

no.title: Pills under layers
no.t: Some see ==pilling under makeup or other products==, and it can peel off in places.

tip.t: Use a thin layer and give it time to set before makeup.

no.title: Heavy on oily skin
no.t: Turns ==greasy on oily skin and in hot, humid weather==, so it's a cool-season pick.

no.title: Not made for sweat
no.t: ==Not water resistant==, and it can go foamy with sweat.

cosrx-balancium-comfort-ceramide-cream.bottom: A thick, balm-like ceramide cream with bergamot oil and a citrus scent. It suits dry and sensitized skin at night. The catch: the scent bothers some, and it sits heavy on oily skin.

yes.title: Comfort for very dry skin
yes.t: ==Soft, cushioned skin== on dry, dehydrated faces through cold, dry weather.

yes.title: Soothing last step
yes.t: ==Leaves sensitized skin soft by morning== for some, including after over-exfoliating.

yes.title: Matte balm finish
yes.t: A thick, balmy cream that ==settles matte instead of shiny== for many.

no.title: Bergamot scent bothers some
no.t: A citrus scent that is ==strong for some and faint for others==, and it is not fragrance-free.

no.title: Stings some irritated skin
no.t: ==Stinging or itching== can show up on skin that is already irritated.

no.title: Heavy for some
no.t: ==Sits on top of the skin and feels tacky==; oily skin and daytime wear suit it less.

cosrx-bha-blackhead-power-liquid.bottom: A fragrance-free betaine salicylate liquid with niacinamide, milder than most BHA exfoliants. It suits oily and combination skin. The catch: it is too gentle for stubborn blackheads and breaks some faces out.

yes.title: Mild first BHA
yes.t: Most can use it ==two or three times a week without stinging==, including some very reactive skin.

yes.title: Cleaner-looking nose pores
yes.t: Nose blackheads and clogged pores ==look smaller and cleaner within two to four weeks==.

yes.title: Doesn't dry skin out
yes.t: Feels ==watery and comfortable==, and some dry skin finds it hydrating.

yes.title: Gentler than Paula's Choice
yes.t: A ==lower-priced route to BHA==, and gentler than Paula's Choice for plenty of skin.

no.title: Too mild for stubborn clogs
no.t: ==No change in blackheads or closed comedones== after months for some, who go back to stronger BHA.

alt.t: Paula's Choice 2% BHA, the stronger liquid that those who see no change often move to.

no.title: Splits on breakouts
no.t: ==Clears some faces and brings new clogs and bumps to others==, sometimes after a month-long purge.

tip.t: Start two or three times a week, not daily, then build up.

no.title: Irritates some skin
no.t: ==Redness, itching or peeling== show up for some, mainly with daily use or stacked acids.

no.title: Slow to dry, leaks sometimes
no.t: ==Sticky or shiny for a few minutes== on some skin, and the pump leaks on some bottles.

cosrx-full-fit-propolis-honey-overnight-.bottom: A fragrance-free, light jelly mask for the last night step, best on combination and dry-leaning skin. It is too light alone for very dry skin, and propolis does not suit everyone.

yes.title: Light, sinks in fast
yes.t: A jelly that ==melts in without a sticky or gummy feel==, light enough for daytime wear.

yes.title: Hydrated by morning
yes.t: Skin wakes up ==soft and well hydrated== after one or two nights.

yes.title: Calms irritated skin
yes.t: Leaves ==flared, red skin looking calmer==, including before a period.

yes.title: Fine on combination skin
yes.t: Doesn't turn oily ==even on an oily T-zone or breakout-prone skin==.

no.title: Too light for very dry skin
no.t: As the last step ==it can leave very dry skin waking up dry==, since it seals little.

tip.t: Seal it with a cream or balm on top overnight.

no.title: Film if overapplied
no.t: A thin layer is enough, as ==a thick layer leaves a film== and can feel like honey on skin.

no.title: Propolis can trigger reactions
no.t: Propolis and honey ==can bring redness or itchy reactions==, and tiny bumps for some.

cosrx-full-fit-propolis-synergy-toner.bottom: A fragrance-free propolis and honey toner that hydrates richly and gives a soft glow. It suits dry, combination and sensitive skin best. The texture is slightly syrupy, and it itches a few faces.

yes.title: Rich, plumping hydration
yes.t: ==Dry skin feels softer within a week or two==, using only a few drops.

yes.title: Soft dewy glow
yes.t: The ==glow shows straight away== and stays non-sticky even with twice-daily use.

yes.title: Layers and absorbs well
yes.t: ==Absorbs faster and leaves less residue than thicker essences== like Hada Labo.

yes.title: Soothes irritated skin
yes.t: Helps ==over-exfoliated or flare-prone skin settle== when little else is tolerated.

no.title: Heavy in summer
no.t: ==Too thick under daytime sunscreen== in humid weather, and slightly syrupy even alone.

no.title: Itches some faces
no.t: ==Redness or itch can start with the first use or a later bottle==, and fades once stopped.

no.title: Underwhelms some skin
no.t: ==Hydration can fall short for very dry skin==, and results are subtle on others.

cosrx-low-ph-good-morning-gel-cleanser.bottom: A low-pH gel cleanser with a salicylate BHA and tea tree oil, and a strong tea tree smell. It cleans oily and combination skin without a tight feel. Dry skin often finds it drying.

yes.title: Gentle clean on oily skin
yes.t: Lathers lightly and ==rinses clean without a tight feel on normal, oily and combination skin==.

yes.title: Evens out oil
yes.t: ==Keeps oil in check on oily-leaning skin==, and works well as a second cleanser at night.

yes.title: Skin looks clearer over weeks
yes.t: Breakout-prone skin ==looks calmer and clearer within a few weeks== of daily use.

yes.title: A tube goes a long way
yes.t: A tiny amount lathers, so ==one tube lasts months== of daily use.

no.title: Dries out dry skin
no.t: ==Leaves dry or dehydrated skin tight==, and some oily skin gets stripped over months.

tip.t: Use a tiny amount and follow with toner or moisturiser on damp skin.

no.title: Strong tea tree smell
no.t: A ==piney, medicinal tea tree smell== that some like and others cannot stand.

no.title: Stings eyes, flushes some skin
no.t: Can sting if it runs into the eyes, and ==flushes or itches on reactive skin==.

no.title: Tiny bumps for some
no.t: ==Small bumps and blackheads show up on some faces== after weeks of use.

cosrx-one-step-original-clear-pad.bottom: A gentle BHA toner pad with green tea and centella, for oily, combination and breakout-prone skin. It is scented with tea tree and orange peel oils. Daily use is too much for some, and results build slowly.

yes.title: Pimples and blackheads settle faster
yes.t: Pimples ==look flatter sooner==, and blackheads and clogged pores ease within a few weeks.

yes.title: Mild BHA that most skins tolerate
yes.t: A mild BHA that ==doesn't burn or strip==, including on sensitive and dry skin.

yes.title: Pores look smaller and cleaner
yes.t: Pores on the nose and T-zone ==look smaller after a weekend to a few weeks==.
