no.title: Reddens or itches if used daily
no.t: Some faces ==flush, itch or flake if used daily==, especially new to BHA.

tip.t: Use every other night, and skip it on days with other acids.

no.title: Scented with tea tree, orange
no.t: The oils give ==a pine-cleaner scent that fades fast==, so it isn't fragrance-free.

no.title: Slow, modest results
no.t: Works ==gradually rather than overnight==, and stubborn blackheads or acne may barely move.

cosrx-salicylic-acid-daily-gentle-cleans.bottom: A creamy salicylic acid cleanser with tea tree and lemon oils, so it carries a medicinal scent. It suits oily and combination skin. The catch: daily use dries or irritates some faces.

yes.title: Fewer breakouts on oily skin
yes.t: ==Fewer new bumps over time== on oily, breakout-prone skin, with steady use rather than overnight.

yes.title: Tames oil and nose clogs
yes.t: Nose blackheads and sebaceous filaments ==look cleaner within weeks==, with oil kept in check.

yes.title: Mild for a salicylic wash
yes.t: ==Gentle enough to use daily== for many, including some sensitive skin that dislikes other acids.

yes.title: Small amounts go far
yes.t: Two pea-sized amounts cover the face, so ==a tube lasts a long time==.

no.title: Dries or tightens some skin
no.t: ==Tightness and peeling== build up with daily use, in cold weather, or when washing all over.

tip.t: Wash once a day or every other day, then follow with a moisturizer.

no.title: Splits on breakouts
no.t: ==Clears some faces and brings new bumps or cysts to others==, often on the forehead and cheeks.

no.title: Stings or burns for some
no.t: ==Burning, redness or a damaged barrier== show up for some, sometimes within days.

no.title: Scented, not fragrance-free

cosrx-the-6-peptide-skin-booster-serum.bottom: A fragrance-free, watery peptide serum that adds light hydration and a little bounce. It layers easily, even on oily skin. Expect a hydrating step, not visible anti-aging, and it breaks a few people out.

yes.title: Light, fast-absorbing hydration
yes.t: A near-water texture that ==sinks in at once without stickiness or pilling==.

yes.title: Layers under anything
yes.t: ==Slots under other serums and creams== in a routine and stays out of the way.

yes.title: Smoother, plumper look
yes.t: Skin looks ==smoother and a touch plumper after a few weeks of daily use==.

yes.title: Fine on oily skin
yes.t: On oily skin ==it settles to a comfortable finish with less T-zone shine==.

no.title: Mild hydration, little else
no.t: ==Hydrates lightly and does little beyond that==; no visible anti-aging change is reported.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: ==Small red or under-the-skin bumps== show up on some faces; others use it for months without a spot.

no.title: Peptide amounts not stated
no.t: ==The label gives no peptide percentages==, so its strength is a guess.

cosrx-the-retinol-0-1-cream.bottom: A fragrance-free 0.1% retinol cream that is easy to start with. Skin feels soft, but it can irritate some, especially near the eyes.

yes.title: Beginner-friendly retinol
yes.t: Mostly ==little purging or irritation== in the first weeks, even for sensitive skin.

yes.title: Soft, not dried out
yes.t: Dry skin ==feels soft and moisturized== rather than dried out.

no.title: Irritates a few
no.t: A few get ==months of irritation or lingering bumps==, and eyes can dry out if used there.

cosrx-the-retinol-0-5-oil.bottom: A fragrance-free retinol oil that absorbs into dry skin without much irritation. It breaks some people out and needs fridge storage.

yes.title: Soft on dry skin
yes.t: Dry skin ==stays hydrated, with little flaking beyond the first week==.

yes.title: Light and absorbs
yes.t: A silky oil that ==absorbs in 10 to 20 minutes== without a greasy finish.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: Oily, congested skin may ==break out within days or weeks==, possibly from the oil.

tip.t: Start with a few drops and build up slowly.

no.title: Fridge storage
no.t: Has to be ==kept in the fridge==, a hassle if you travel.

cosrx-the-vitamin-c-23-serum.bottom: A fragrance-free 23% vitamin C serum that brightens visibly for some faces. It is strong, smells metallic, and stings or breaks some skin out, so it is not a gentle starter.

yes.title: Brightens and evens tone
yes.t: ==Brightening can show within days to a couple of weeks==, and fades if you stop using it.

yes.title: Works where others didn't
yes.t: Often ==the one vitamin C that shows a result== after other serums did nothing.

yes.title: Dark marks fade slowly
yes.t: Marks ==fade gradually over weeks==, not overnight, with steady use.

no.title: Strong at 23%
no.t: Can ==sting, burn or break skin out==, sometimes taking weeks to settle.

no.title: Smells unpleasant
no.t: No added fragrance, yet it ==smells strongly metallic and meaty==, a deal-breaker for some.

no.title: No visible result for some
no.t: ==Months of use brought no change== for a few, even with steady nightly application.

no.title: Sticky and short-lived
no.t: Feels syrupy and sticky, ==stains and oxidizes quickly== in a small bottle.

cosrx-ultimate-nourishing-rice-overnight.bottom: A fragrance-free, lotion-light rice mask that works as a night cream for dry skin. It breaks some people out.

yes.title: Soft, plump dry skin by morning
yes.t: Dry, dehydrated skin ==wakes up plump and soft==, used alone or as the last step.

yes.title: Light enough for daytime
yes.t: Sinks in fast for some, so ==a thin layer can double as a day moisturizer==.

yes.title: Comfortable on reactive skin
yes.t: Fragrance-free and ==calming on many dry, sensitive faces==, with redness settling.

yes.title: Brighter-looking skin
yes.t: Skin looks ==smoother and brighter by morning==, without a heavy feel for some.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: Whiteheads and closed bumps ==show up for some within days or weeks==.

tip.t: Use it once or twice a week rather than every night.

no.title: Greasy on oily skin
no.t: Oily and combination skin can ==wake up shiny and greasy==, worst in summer heat.

no.title: Jars can spoil
no.t: Jars have ==gone rancid or yellow within months==, mostly in hot, humid places.

no.title: Too thin for some dry skin
no.t: Some dry skin finds it ==too light to last the night== or no better than a lotion.

cosrx-ultra-light-invisible-sunscreen-sp.bottom: A fragrance-free SPF 50 that wears very light with no white cast. It suits normal and combination skin, including deeper tones. It irritates some skin and can pill.

yes.title: No white cast, very light
yes.t: ==Disappears on the skin, deeper tones included==, and feels weightless in humid weather.

yes.title: Stays put when you sweat
yes.t: ==Doesn't sting the eyes or ball up== under a mask or at the collar.

no.title: Irritated some skin
no.t: ==Stinging, redness and bumps== came up for some, who blame the witch hazel.

no.title: Pills when layered
no.t: ==Pills over other products== and on a second application, especially with a thick layer.

dr-jart-cicapair-tiger-grass-cream.bottom: A dense, fragrance-free centella cream that tones down redness and suits sensitive skin. It is pricey.

yes.title: Redness looks calmer
yes.t: Flushing and pink cheeks ==look calmer soon after it goes on==.

yes.title: Easy on sensitive skin
yes.t: No added fragrance, and ==comfortable on very sensitive, breakout-prone skin==.

yes.title: Dense but absorbs
yes.t: A thick cream that ==absorbs without leaving a film==.

no.title: Catches on dry patches
no.t: ==Sticks to dry patches== and pills slightly over other moisturizers.

no.title: Thick in warm weather
no.t: The dense texture ==feels heavy to some in summer==.

no.title: Pricey for the job
no.t: Cheaper creams would do ==the same job== on many skins.

drunk-elephant-a-passioni-retinol-cream.bottom: A fragrance-free 1% retinol cream that leaves skin smoother and glowier with steady use. Start twice a week and mix it with moisturizer, since it can peel and burn at first. Results are hit or miss, and the tube is pricey.

yes.title: Smoother, glowier skin
yes.t: Skin looks ==smoother and glowier within weeks==, and forehead lines soften over a few months.

yes.title: Many adapt with a slow start
yes.t: A ==slow build-up from twice a week== lets many skins settle without peeling.

yes.title: A little goes a long way
yes.t: A ==thin layer is enough==, so one tube lasts for months.

no.title: Can burn and peel
no.t: Can burn or peel, ==especially in the first week or when used nightly from the start==.

tip.t: Mix it with moisturizer and start one or two nights a week.

no.title: Hit or miss results
no.t: Results split: ==some see nothing after months of steady use==, others see a clear change.

no.title: High price for a small tube
no.t: ==A high price for a small tube==, and cheaper retinols do a similar job for some.

drunk-elephant-b-hydra-intensive-hydrati.bottom: A fragrance-free, silicone-free hydrating serum with a light gel feel, best as a base layer under cream. Results split, and it is pricey next to basic hyaluronic serums.

yes.title: A hydrating base layer
yes.t: Works ==under moisturizer, not instead of it==, and plumps skin after a few weeks.

yes.title: Fine for breakout-prone skin
yes.t: Sits ==without clogging or causing pimples== on oily, breakout-prone skin.

yes.title: Layers without pilling
yes.t: Absorbs quickly and ==layers under other products without pilling==.

yes.title: Comfortable on dry skin
yes.t: Dry, even semi-sensitive skin often finds it ==nourishing and calm==.

no.title: Does little for some
no.t: Can feel ==no different from a basic hyaluronic serum==, and sometimes not hydrating at all.

alt.t: The Ordinary's hyaluronic serum gives similar hydration for less, by some accounts.

no.title: Costly for what it is
no.t: Cheaper serums ==give a similar plump feel==, so the price is hard to justify.

no.title: Can sting irritated skin
no.t: It ==can burn when skin is already irritated==, and in one case swelled.

drunk-elephant-beste-no-9-jelly-cleanser.bottom: A fragrance-free jelly cleanser that foams lightly and lifts makeup and sunscreen in one wash. It's non-stripping on most skin types. It's pricey, and a few faces react or find it drying.

yes.title: Cleans without stripping
yes.t: Leaves ==skin soft rather than tight== on most skin types, including many dry and sensitive faces.

yes.title: Takes off makeup and SPF
yes.t: Lifts ==tinted sunscreen and long-wear concealer== in a single wash.

yes.title: Fine for breakout-prone skin
yes.t: Comedones look ==quieter within a week or so==, with no new bumps for most.

no.title: Costly for a cleanser
no.t: A ==premium price for a wash-off product==, even for those who like it.

tip.t: Try a mini or trial size before buying the full bottle.

no.title: Can irritate some skin
no.t: ==Redness, hives or swollen eyelids== for a few, and it stings if it gets in the eyes.

no.title: Dries out some skin
no.t: ==Leaves some combination or dry skin tight==, with oil bouncing back by midday.

drunk-elephant-c-firma-fresh-day-serum.bottom: A 15% vitamin C day serum you mix from powder, aimed at dull skin and dark spots. It oxidizes fast, smells strong and breaks some people out.

yes.title: Brighter within weeks
yes.t: Skin looks ==brighter after a couple of weeks== of morning use, if it stays fresh.

yes.title: Dark spots lighten slowly
yes.t: ==Dark spots and scars look lighter over months==, not days.

yes.title: A long-term staple
yes.t: ==Stays in routines for years==, including on sensitive skin.

no.title: Oxidizes fast
no.t: The mix ==turns orange or brown within weeks== and loses its punch.

tip.t: Keep it in the fridge and use it up quickly.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: ==Blackheads, bumps or a full breakout== show up on some faces, with stinging for a few.

no.title: Strong, off-putting smell
no.t: ==Smells strongly== of fish or hot dogs to some, though it fades for a few.

no.title: Sticky feel, powder clumps
no.t: ==Tacky on skin and prone to pilling==; the powder does not always dissolve.

drunk-elephant-lala-retro-whipped-cream.bottom: A fragrance-free, ceramide-rich whipped cream, best as a night cream for dry skin in the cold. It sits heavy on oily skin, and the price is steep for a jar that goes fast.

yes.title: Deep, comfortable moisture
yes.t: Wakes skin ==soft and cushioned, with no flaking== when it is dry or dehydrated.

yes.title: Easy on very sensitive skin
yes.t: ==Calming and gentle on very sensitive, dry skin== over months of nightly use.

yes.title: Made for cold weather
yes.t: ==Dry, flaky winter skin settles== under it, and it sits well over a retinoid.

yes.title: Whipped feel that melts in
yes.t: Sinks in with a ==soft, non-shiny finish on many skins==, even under sunscreen.

no.title: Heavy, can sit on skin
no.t: Thick enough to ==sit on top of oily, clog-prone or very flaky skin for hours==.

tip.t: Keep it for night or cold weather, and use a small amount.

no.title: Costly for how fast it goes
no.t: ==A jar can be gone in a month==, and a drugstore cream can do a similar job.

no.title: Can bring breakouts
no.t: Whiteheads or deeper bumps have followed for some, ==though plenty see no congestion==.

no.title: Can sting a reactive face
no.t: ==Burning or tightness can show up== on days when the skin is already reactive.

drunk-elephant-t-l-c-framboos-glycolic-n.bottom: A fragrance-free AHA and BHA night serum for smoother, brighter-looking skin. Tolerance varies, so start slowly. It is expensive for the size.

yes.title: Smoother, clearer-looking texture
yes.t: Texture and clogged pores look ==calmer and smoother with regular use==.

yes.title: Marks and dullness fade
yes.t: Marks and dull patches ==look lighter and brighter over a few weeks==.

yes.title: Two acids in one bottle
yes.t: ==Glycolic and salicylic acid in one step==, so it can stand in for two exfoliants.

yes.title: Often tolerated by sensitive skin
yes.t: ==Many sensitive and dry skins tolerate it== when used every other night.

no.title: Can sting, dry or peel
no.t: ==Stings, dries or peels some skin==, mostly if used nightly or without moisturizer.

tip.t: Start every second or third night and moisturize over it.

no.title: Pricey for the size
no.t: ==Costs a lot per use==, and cheaper AHA and BHA serums can do much the same.

no.title: Splits breakout-prone skin
no.t: Opinion splits on breakout-prone skin: ==it quiets some bumps and sets off new ones in others==.

no.title: Little change for some
no.t: ==Skin can show no change after a month or two==, and some get used to it quickly.

eltamd-uv-clear-broad-spectrum-spf-46.bottom: A fragrance-free SPF 46 with zinc oxide and 5% niacinamide that wears like a thin, light lotion. It suits breakout-prone, sensitive and combination skin, with little white cast on most. It pills under some moisturizers and makeup, breaks a few people out, and costs a lot.

yes.title: Thin, lotion-like feel
yes.t: ==Light enough to replace a morning moisturizer== for some, with no heavy layer.

yes.title: Gentle on sensitive skin
yes.t: ==Redness looks calmer with daily use==, and it feels soothing on reactive skin.

yes.title: Stays clear for many
yes.t: Many ==breakout-prone faces use it for years== without extra bumps.

yes.title: Little white cast
yes.t: ==Blends clear on most skin==; reapplying can build a faint cast on deeper tones.

no.title: Pills under moisturizer
no.t: ==Rolls into crumbs== over some moisturizers and makeup, however long you wait.

tip.t: Wait 10 to 20 minutes after moisturizer before applying.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: ==Can bring cysts or whiteheads within a week== for some, even though it's sold for breakout-prone skin.

no.title: Stings or itches some skin
no.t: Can ==turn on you after years of use or once retinol starts==, with burning or itchy red patches.

no.title: Finish splits opinion
no.t: Reads ==satin-matte on many faces, shiny and greasy on oily skin== as the day goes on.

eltamd-uv-daily-broad-spectrum-spf-40.bottom: A fragrance-free zinc oxide SPF 40 with hyaluronic acid that feels like a light moisturizer. It suits normal and dry skin, but it breaks some people out, and it costs a lot.

yes.title: Feels like a moisturizer
yes.t: A ==cool, creamy lotion that hydrates== as it goes on, with a light feel.

yes.title: Layers under foundation
yes.t: ==Sinks in quickly and sits neatly under foundation== for many, with a smooth base.

yes.title: Easy on eyes and skin
yes.t: ==Doesn't sting the eyes==, which zinc-only wearers often prefer, and stays calm on sensitive skin.

yes.title: Clear for some, even oily skin
yes.t: Some wear it for years with ==no clogged pores==, oily skin included.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: Closed bumps and breakouts show up for some, ==often within days of daily use==.

no.title: White cast on deeper skin
no.t: Leaves ==a subtle white cast on deeper tones==, and some white in brows and hairline.

no.title: Pills with some layers
no.t: Can ==pill over vitamin C or other products underneath==.

no.title: Greasy look for some
no.t: Dries ==slightly shiny or greasy-looking== on some skin.

eltamd-uv-physical-broad-spectrum-spf-41.bottom: A fragrance-free tinted mineral SPF 41 with a matte-to-satin finish. Best on fair to light skin; deeper tones see a pale or orange cast.

yes.title: Tint blends on fair skin
yes.t: The sheer tint ==blends into fair to light skin== and can stand in for foundation.

yes.title: Gentle mineral formula
yes.t: Mineral formula that ==didn't sting==, even around the eyes or after a rough skin day.

yes.title: Smooth, primer-like finish
yes.t: A ==demi-matte finish that grips makeup== well.

yes.title: Big tube lasts a while
yes.t: ==A large tube lasts months==, which makes the price easier to take.

no.title: Tint can look off
no.t: The tint ==looks pale, dusty or orange== on deeper skin and on some fair skin.

no.title: Can feel drying
no.t: ==Can show dry patches and peeling== on drier skin.

no.title: Pills or turns greasy
no.t: ==Worst on oily skin in humid heat==, where it pills or slides.

no.title: Irritates or breaks out some
no.t: Despite its ==sensitive-skin label==, some faces sting or break out.

eltamd-uv-restore-broad-spectrum-spf-40.bottom: A fragrance-free mineral SPF 40, also sold tinted, that spreads easily with little white cast. It suits reactive and normal-to-dry skin. It can look greasy and costs a lot.

yes.title: Spreads easily, little cast
yes.t: Glides on with ==no ghostly cast and no bumps== for skin that clogs easily.

yes.title: Tolerated by reactive skin
yes.t: ==Sits well on reactive skin== that cannot use other sunscreens, and feels hydrating on normal-to-dry.

no.title: Can look greasy
no.t: ==Leaves a slick, shiny finish== on some, who blot through the day.

no.title: Price has climbed
no.t: ==The price has more than doubled since 2022==, a sore point for a daily sunscreen.

eucerin-clear-skin-spf-50-face-sunscreen.bottom: A fragrance-free SPF 50 sold for oily skin. It often turns greasy on very oily faces. It stings eyes and breaks out some faces.

yes.title: Light for some
yes.t: Some ==don't break out and find it light at first== on skin.

no.title: Greasy on oily skin
no.t: ==Goes on thick, dries quickly, then looks oily within seconds== on very oily skin.

no.title: Eye stinging
no.t: ==Stung and watered eyes==, and caused bumps on oily, blemish-prone skin.

first-aid-beauty-facial-radiance-pads.bottom: Fragrance-free exfoliating pads with glycolic and lactic acid, mild enough to start with. They smooth tone and texture; very sensitive skin can still redden.

yes.t: Skin that fears acids ==often tolerates them once or twice a week==, some even daily.

yes.t: Complexion looks ==fresher and smoother after several weeks== of regular use.

no.title: Irritates some skin

no.title: Soaked pads, steep price
no.t: Pads are ==heavily saturated==, so product is wasted and the price feels steep.

no.title: Not for everyone
no.t: Some saw ==no change, or small bumps that stayed==, even after weeks.

first-aid-beauty-pure-skin-face-cleanser.bottom: A fragrance-free cream-foam cleanser that cleans without tightness, for dry, sensitive skin. It handles sunscreen and light makeup. The catch: it can't lift heavy makeup, and some bottles smell off.

yes.title: Gentle, no tight feeling
yes.t: Cleans ==without stripping or tightness==, even on sensitive skin.

yes.title: Soft finish for dry skin

yes.title: Lifts sunscreen, light makeup
yes.t: ==Takes off sunscreen and light makeup==, best as a second cleanse.

yes.t: ==A small amount goes a long way==, so a tube lasts.

no.t: Repurchased bottles ==sometimes smell off==, though skin still tolerated them for some.

first-aid-beauty-ultra-repair-cream.bottom: A thick oat and ceramide cream for dry, flaky and irritated skin, best as a night cream. Eucalyptus oil stings some faces; others break out.

yes.title: Deep moisture for dry skin
yes.t: Thick enough for winter: ==dry, flaky patches look smoother within weeks==.

yes.title: Soothes irritated skin
yes.t: ==Tones down redness and stinging== when skin is raw or over-exfoliated, sometimes within days.

yes.title: Lighter feel than it looks
yes.t: Thick in the jar but ==sinks in without a greasy film==, so it sits fine on combination skin.

yes.title: Settles retinoid dryness
yes.t: Over a retinoid it ==keeps dry, tight skin comfortable== through the dry weeks.

no.title: Eucalyptus oil can sting

no.t: Gives ==small whiteheads and closed comedones== to some, while others stay clear.

no.title: Thin for the driest skin
no.t: On very dry skin ==it can fall short, with tightness and flaking returning==.

no.title: Pills over other products
no.t: ==Rolls into crumbs over serums and oils==, so many keep it for night.

glow-recipe-avocado-ceramide-moisture-ba.bottom: A runny, creamy gel cleanser that cleans without stripping, good for dry and sensitive skin. It has a light scent and the cap pours out too much.

yes.title: Cleans without stripping
yes.t: ==Leaves skin soft rather than tight==, even on dry, sensitive skin.

no.t: A light avocado scent that ==can rule it out for very reactive skin==.

glow-recipe-guava-vitamin-c-bright-eye-g.bottom: A light, whipped eye gel cream with vitamin C and no added fragrance. It hydrates and sits well under makeup. The effect is modest and it irritates some eyes.

no.t: ==Doesn't sink in==: stays slippery, transfers and looks oily rather than dewy.

no.title: Hard to layer
no.t: ==Too slippery== to wear under or over makeup.

glow-recipe-watermelon-glow-niacinamide-.bottom: A scented gel serum with niacinamide, used mostly as a dewy primer or glow booster under makeup. It hydrates lightly but stays tacky. Skin benefits are modest for the price.

yes.title: Glowy primer under makeup
yes.t: Gives ==a dewy base that helps foundation sit smoothly==, or can be mixed in for glow.

yes.title: Hydrating, plumping glow
yes.t: A light gel that ==leaves dry and sensitive skin hydrated and plump==.

yes.title: Calm on many sensitive faces
yes.t: ==Often sits calmly on sensitive, breakout-prone skin==, and eases redness for some.

yes.title: Thin, slips on easily
yes.t: A thin emulsion that ==spreads easily with a subtle, shimmer-free sheen==.

no.title: Stays tacky once applied
no.t: Dries ==sticky or tacky under sunscreen and tinted moisturizer==, and can look greasy on oily skin.

tip.t: Use a few drops and let it dry before the next layer.

no.title: Little change beyond the glow
no.t: ==Little visible change to the skin itself== beyond glow, for a price above basic niacinamide serums.

no.title: Scented, bothers some skin
no.t: A ==sweet, candy-like watermelon scent== that irritates some skin and is strong if you dislike fragrance.

no.title: Breaks out some skin
no.t: ==Deep pimples and breakouts follow for some==, and some blame the niacinamide.

glow-recipe-watermelon-glow-pha-bha-pore.bottom: A scented, gel-like toner with mild acids, used for hydration and a smoother look to pores. It is more hydrating than exfoliating. The sweet scent and price put some off.

yes.title: Hydrating, bouncy gel feel
yes.t: A ==light, plumping veil of hydration== that layers under serums and moisturizer.

yes.title: Gentle for most skin
yes.t: Usually ==comfortable for daily use, even on sensitive, breakout-prone skin==.

yes.title: Pores look smoother
yes.t: Pores look ==smoother and less visible after a few weeks== of regular use.

yes.title: Quick to absorb
yes.t: Soaks in fast, so ==makeup and sunscreen layer on top easily==.

no.title: Strong sweet scent
no.t: A ==sugary watermelon scent== that is overpowering or oddly cucumber-like for sensitive noses.

no.title: Mild effect, high price
no.t: ==Little visible exfoliating effect==, and the price is high for a hydrating toner.

no.title: Irritates some skin
no.t: Flaking, burning or breakouts ==hit some skin, especially with twice-daily use==.

tip.t: Use it once a day at night rather than twice, and ease in over a week.

glow-recipe-watermelon-glow-ultra-fine-m.bottom: A fine, watermelon-scented mist that leaves skin fresh and glowy. It suits dry to combination skin as a daily refresher. The scent is strong and the price is high.

yes.title: Fresh, glowy hydration
yes.t: A ==light, non-greasy burst of moisture== used after cleansing or through the day.

yes.title: Sets makeup, adds glow
yes.t: ==A healthy glow with or without makeup==, and it helps set makeup in place.

no.title: Strong fruity scent
no.t: A ==strong, fairly artificial watermelon scent==; a poor fit if you avoid fragrance.

no.title: Quality can slip
no.t: ==An uneven spray or a bottle that turned dark and smelled off== turned up in a few cases.

hada-labo-tokyo-gentle-hydrating-facial-.bottom: A fragrance-free foaming cleanser that leaves dry and sensitive skin soft. It lathers well from a small amount. It breaks out or tightens some faces.

yes.title: Soft, not tight
yes.t: Leaves skin ==clean but soft, unlike many foaming cleansers==, even when very dry.

yes.title: Gentle and removes makeup
yes.t: Foams lightly from ==a tiny amount without stinging or stripping==.

no.title: Breakouts for some
no.t: Led to ==closed bumps and clogged pores== on breakout-prone faces.

no.title: Tight for some
no.t: Left ==dehydrated skin tight, with dry patches== after a few days.

hada-labo-tokyo-skin-plumping-gel-cream.bottom: A fragrance-free hyaluronic gel cream that plumps and hydrates without butters. It suits dry to combination skin and works best on damp skin. The catch is that it clogs some pores.

yes.title: Plump, dewy hydration
yes.t: Skin looks ==plump and stays hydrated through the day==, even in dry climates.

yes.title: Easy on dry, reactive skin
yes.t: Moisturizes ==without heavy butters or stinging==, and sits well on dry, sensitive skin.

yes.title: Layers best on damp skin
yes.t: A clear gel that ==works best pressed onto damp skin== under moisturizer or sunscreen.

no.title: Clogs some pores
no.t: ==Rough bumps and whiteheads appear within days== for some, and fade after stopping.

no.title: Pills with some layers
no.t: Thick creams and makeup can ==clump or roll off the gel== unless it dries down first.

tip.t: Apply to damp skin and let it dry down before the next layer.

no.title: Tacky on oily skin
no.t: Can feel ==thick and tacky on oily skin== or in humid weather.

haruharu-wonder-black-rice-hyaluronic-to.bottom: A watery hydrating toner that sinks in without stickiness, sold scented (lavender) and fragrance-free. It suits oily, combination and reactive skin; dry skin wants more, and it breaks some people out.

yes.title: Light, watery hydration
yes.t: ==Sinks in with no tackiness==, so it layers easily under serum and moisturizer.

yes.title: Comfortable on sensitive skin
yes.t: No alcohol sting, and ==easy on sensitive skin and alongside tretinoin==.

yes.title: Enough for oily and combo
yes.t: ==Gives oily and combination skin enough moisture== without feeling heavy.

yes.title: Fragrance-free version
yes.t: The unscented bottle ==stays calm on fragrance-sensitive skin== where the lavender original may not.

no.title: Splits opinion on breakouts
no.t: Closed comedones and bumps follow for some, ==while others stay clear through several bottles==.

no.title: Basic hydration for dry skin
no.t: ==Moderate moisture that fades in winter==; a richer essence or cream does more for dry skin.

no.title: Original smells strongly
no.t: The scented original ==smells strongly of lavender==, too much even for lavender lovers.

no.title: Bottle goes quickly
no.t: A thin toner is ==used up fast, so keeping a bottle in stock adds up==.

haruharu-wonder-black-rice-moisture-airy.bottom: A fragrance-free SPF 50 that feels light and moisturizing, with a velvety finish and no white cast. It suits dry to combination skin. It can feel sticky, and it breaks a few people out.

yes.title: No white cast
yes.t: Blends in ==clear on skin, including after reapplying==, and layers without pilling for most.

yes.title: Light, moisturizing feel
yes.t: ==Feels like a light cream==, so some skip a separate moisturizer.

yes.title: Velvety satin finish
yes.t: Dries to ==a natural, velvety look== that is neither shiny nor flat matte.

yes.title: Easy on the eyes
yes.t: ==Rarely stings if it runs into the eyes==, which suits eye-sensitive wearers.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: ==Small pimples show up for a few== even among those who love the feel.

no.title: Irritates some skin
no.t: ==Burns or irritates a few reactive faces== after days of use.

no.title: Sticky or greasy for some
no.t: Can feel ==tacky for 20 to 30 minutes== and turn shiny on oily skin in heat.

no.title: Pills over some creams
no.t: ==Balls up over certain moisturizers== and can break down makeup.

kiehls-ultra-facial-cream.bottom: A fragrance-free cream with squalane that hydrates normal to dry skin without a heavy feel. It also suits sensitive and combination skin. It pills under sunscreen for some and sits greasy on oily skin.

yes.title: Light but deeply hydrating
yes.t: ==Deep hydration that still feels light==, soaking in fast on normal to dry skin.

yes.title: Easy on reactive skin
yes.t: Fragrance-free and ==burns less than most creams== on sensitive or retinoid-dried skin.

yes.title: Dewy, not oily, on combo skin
yes.t: ==All-day moisture without an oily forehead== on combination skin that runs dry.

no.title: Pills under sunscreen and makeup
no.t: ==Rolls into crumbs== over sunscreen or makeup, and on bare skin for some.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: Brings small bumps or breakouts on some skin, ==including the forehead and T-zone==.

no.title: Heavy on oily skin
no.t: ==Slick and shiny for hours== on oily skin and in humid weather.

no.title: Fades for very dry skin
no.t: On very dry skin ==hydration can fade within hours==, and winter may call for a richer cream.

kravebeauty-beet-the-sun-spf-40.bottom: A fragrance-free SPF 40 with a light feel and little white cast. The finish is dewy and turns shiny on oily skin. It can sting the eyes and break out some faces.

yes.title: Light, no white cast
yes.t: Feels ==like almost nothing on the skin==, with no white cast or sunscreen smell.

yes.title: Dewy glow
yes.t: Leaves a ==natural dewy glow on dry and combination skin==.

no.title: Shiny by midday
no.t: ==Looks glossy or greasy within hours== on oily skin and under office light.

no.title: Can sting or break out
no.t: ==Stung some eyes and caused bumps== on a few faces.

kravebeauty-great-barrier-relief.bottom: A light 10% tamanu oil serum for nights or under moisturizer, aimed at irritated, retinoid-dry skin. It has a strong earthy smell that lingers. A few faces react or break out.

yes.title: Rescue for irritated skin
yes.t: Redness and tightness ==settle faster after retinol or over-exfoliating==, without stinging for most.

yes.title: Can stand in for moisturizer
yes.t: ==Cushioned, plump-feeling moisture== that can replace a night cream on normal to oily skin.

yes.title: Calmer breakout-prone skin
yes.t: Pimples ==show up less often and fade faster== for some, within a week or two.

yes.title: Sits well in the daytime
yes.t: Absorbs quickly, so ==it layers under sunscreen and makeup== without a heavy film.

no.title: Strong lingering smell
no.t: An ==earthy, nutty tamanu smell== that sticks to sheets and clothes.

no.title: Can irritate a few
no.t: ==Burned, itched or swelled== for a few, including around the eyes.

tip.t: Keep it away from the eye area.

no.title: Early breakouts for some
no.t: Some get ==bumps in the first days or week==, and a few never settle.

no.title: Thin for very dry skin
no.t: ==Isn't enough alone for very dry skin==, which needs a cream on top.

kravebeauty-kale-lalu-yaha.bottom: A fragrance-free glycolic acid toner with kale and hyaluronic acid. Mild enough for many sensitive skins, though a few react badly and others see little.

yes.title: Mild AHA for sensitive skin
yes.t: Sensitive skin gets ==smoothing without redness or harsh irritation==.

no.title: Reacts badly on some skin
no.t: A few ended up with ==red patches and breakouts that lasted weeks==.

no.title: Results can be subtle
no.t: Some use it for months and ==see no change in texture or dark spots==.

kravebeauty-matcha-hemp-hydrating-cleans.bottom: A fragrance-free, slippy gel cleanser that rinses clean without squeaky tightness for most. Suits dry, combination and sensitive skin; can dry some.

yes.title: Cleans without stripping
yes.t: Rinses ==clean without the squeaky, tight feel== of foaming washes.

yes.title: Leaves skin hydrated
yes.t: Leaves skin ==soft and hydrated, even on dry skin==, as a daily or morning wash.

no.title: Dries some skin
no.t: ==Leaves some dry and combination skin tight== after rinsing.

no.title: Irritates some skin
no.t: ==Stings the eyes or irritates== a few, despite the gentle reputation.

kravebeauty-oat-so-simple-water-cream.bottom: A fragrance-free water cream that feels light and watery on the skin. It suits warm weather and daytime use. Dry skin and cold air need more cushion.

yes.title: Light and watery
yes.t: Creamy in the hand, then ==breaks into a fresh, non-sticky feel==; good for summer and humid climates.

yes.title: Well tolerated by some reactive skin
yes.t: Some very reactive skin ==copes with it where other moisturizers brought itchy bumps==.

no.title: Too light for dry skin
no.t: Can leave skin tight in dry or cold air; ==dry skin needs an oil or a heavier cream on top==.

no.title: Irritated some skin
no.t: ==Bumps, redness or a slimy feel== showed up for some breakout-prone and oily, sensitive skin.

la-roche-posay-anthelios-melt-in-milk-su.bottom: A fragrance-free SPF 60 milk with a dewy, moisturized finish, best on dry, normal and sensitive skin. Oily skin often finds it greasy, and it can pill or leave a cast.

yes.title: Dewy, moisturized finish
yes.t: Leaves ==a glowy, cushioned finish== that feels like a moisturizer step, mostly on dry and normal skin.

yes.title: Rubs in easily
yes.t: A thin milk that ==blends in without much white cast== for many, mostly on light to medium tones.

yes.title: Kind to sensitive skin
yes.t: Often ==goes on without stinging or itching== on very sensitive skin.

no.title: Greasy on oily skin
no.t: Sits ==shiny and tacky on oily and combination skin==, and can transfer onto clothes.

no.title: Pills over other products
no.t: Can ==roll into pills over many moisturizers and under makeup==.

no.title: Stings some eyes and skin
no.t: Some faces get ==stinging on application, and it can run into the eyes==.

no.title: White cast for some
no.t: Leaves ==a chalky white cast on some skin==, mostly deeper tones and stubble.

la-roche-posay-cicaplast-balm-b5.bottom: A fragrance-free panthenol balm for irritated or retinoid-dried skin, best as a thin night layer. It's thick and shiny for daytime, and it clogs some skin. Use it as a seal over moisturizer, not a moisturizer on its own.

yes.title: Settles retinoid flaking
yes.t: Over moisturizer at night, it ==eases the peeling and tightness of retinol or tretinoin== within days.

yes.title: Gentle on touchy skin
yes.t: No fragrance, and ==one of the few creams that rarely stings== very reactive, red-prone skin.

yes.title: Rescue for over-exfoliated skin
yes.t: After too many actives, ==redness and tightness settle within days== when it's the main thing applied.

yes.title: Seals dry patches in winter
yes.t: A little goes a long way: ==a thin layer over moisturizer== holds on cold cheeks and cracked spots.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: Brings ==whiteheads or cysts within days== for some, mostly when spread over the whole face.

tip.t: Dab it on dry patches or over a moisturizer rather than on bare skin.

alt.t: Avène Cicalfate, which some skin that breaks out from this balm tolerates better.

no.title: Heavy and shiny by day
no.t: Too ==thick and greasy for daytime or oily skin==, and it can pill under makeup.

tip.t: Keep it for night and use a very small amount.

no.title: Can sting for some
no.t: Can burn, ==mainly on raw, broken skin or near the eyes==, though it's mild on intact skin.

no.title: Not a moisturizer on its own
no.t: Works as a seal: ==feels drying on very dry skin== unless layered over hydration.

la-roche-posay-effaclar-gel-cleanser-for.bottom: A fragranced foaming gel cleanser for oily skin that cuts shine and leaves a very clean feel. Dry and sensitive skin often finds it tight. It breaks some people out.

yes.title: Cuts oil and shine
yes.t: A foaming gel that ==leaves oily skin feeling clean and balanced== from the first use.

yes.title: Oily, blemish-prone faces look calmer
yes.t: Some oily, breakout-prone faces ==look clearer within a few weeks==.

yes.title: Tolerated by some sensitive skin
yes.t: Some sensitive and combination skin ==uses it for years== without a stripped feel.

no.title: Dries and tightens
no.t: ==Leaves skin tight and dry== after each wash, even on very oily skin.

tip.t: Follow with a hydrating moisturizer to offset the tight feel.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: ==Sets off breakouts on some skin== within about two weeks.

no.title: Scent bothers some
no.t: The ==fragrance puts some people off== and left a few sensitive faces red.

la-roche-posay-effaclar-medicated-gel-cl.bottom: A fragrance-free 2% salicylic gel cleanser for oily, breakout-prone skin. It cleans pores without much dryness. The tube leaks and the results are mixed.

yes.title: Skin looks clearer
yes.t: Pores feel clean and ==breakouts look calmer after a few months of daily use==.

yes.title: Cleans without burning
yes.t: A gel that ==lifts the day off without the sting== some other cleansers bring.

no.title: Messy, leaky packaging
no.t: The runny gel ==comes out too fast and leaks from loose caps==.

no.title: Does nothing for some
no.t: ==No change in blackheads or breakouts== after months, for some.

la-roche-posay-hyalu-b5-pure-hyaluronic-.bottom: A scented hyaluronic acid serum with vitamin B5 that leaves a plump, dewy look. It suits normal to dry skin under a moisturizer. The catch: the fragrance is strong, and it turns oily skin shinier.

yes.title: Plump, dewy skin
yes.t: Skin looks ==plump and radiant straight away==, with fine lines softened.

yes.title: Layers well
yes.t: Sits well ==under vitamin C and moisturizer==, and absorbs best over damp skin or a mist.

yes.title: Beats budget HA serums
yes.t: ==Hydrates more and pills less than The Ordinary's HA== for some.

no.title: Strong floral fragrance
no.t: Opens with an ==overwhelming floral perfume==, and it made a few sneeze or turn red.

no.title: Too much for oily skin
no.t: ==Leaves oily and combination skin shinier== and can bring chin pimples.

no.title: Costly for a simple serum
no.t: A ==high price for a hyaluronic serum==, a letdown if the scent is wrong for you.

la-roche-posay-retinol-b3-pure-retinol-s.bottom: A scented pure retinol serum with niacinamide, pitched at people new to retinol. It is usually tolerated well. It has a strong perfume smell, can bring early breakouts and works slowly.

yes.title: Beginner-friendly retinol
yes.t: A first retinol that is ==usually tolerated over months== with only minor dryness.

yes.title: Tone looks brighter
yes.t: Tone looks ==brighter and more even after about two to six weeks== of steady use.

yes.title: Light, easy to spread
yes.t: A very liquid serum that ==spreads easily and feels moisturizing==.

no.title: Early breakouts and dryness
no.t: ==Breakouts and dry patches come in the first weeks== for some, and not all settle.

tip.t: Start one or two nights a week and keep skin well moisturized.

no.title: Strong perfume smell
no.t: Contains fragrance, and ==the perfume smell is strong== for scent-sensitive skin.

no.title: Results stay modest
no.t: ==Progress plateaus after a few months== for some, who then want a stronger retinol.

la-roche-posay-toleriane-double-repair-f.bottom: A fragrance-free ceramide and niacinamide moisturizer with a light, milky feel. Many love it for dry skin.

yes.title: Melts in, never heavy
yes.t: A milky lotion that ==absorbs fast without an oily or heavy finish==.

yes.title: Steady hydration
yes.t: Skin stays ==comfortably hydrated through dry winters== and retinoid dryness.

yes.title: Comfortable on many sensitive skins
yes.t: Fragrance-free and ==comfortable for many sensitive faces==, even when red or flaking.

yes.title: Fair price, lasts a season
yes.t: A drugstore-priced tube that ==lasts about a season== for daily face use.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: Whiteheads and closed bumps ==appear within days for some==, mostly on clog-prone skin.

alt.t: Vanicream Daily, which breakout-prone and reactive faces settled on instead.

no.title: Pills under sunscreen
no.t: Rolls into crumbs under sunscreen or makeup, ==even with light touch==.

tip.t: Pat it in, add a serum underneath and avoid rubbing over it.

no.title: Burns or flushes some skin
no.t: It can ==sting or redden on contact== for some sensitive skin.

la-roche-posay-toleriane-double-repair-f.bottom: A fragrance-free moisturizer with SPF 30 and ceramides, rich enough for dry skin. It looks greasy on oily skin and can pill under makeup.

yes.title: Daily moisturizer with SPF
yes.t: A comfortable one-step day cream that ==spreads easily and feels moisturizing==.

yes.title: Rich enough for dry skin
yes.t: One of the few sunscreens ==rich enough for really dry skin==.

no.title: Greasy on oily skin
no.t: Leaves oily skin ==shiny, even in a small amount==.

no.title: Can pill under makeup
no.t: Needs ==time to absorb fully before makeup==, or it can pill.

la-roche-posay-toleriane-double-repair-m.bottom: A fragrance-free matte moisturizer with SPF 30, made for oily skin. It is light and oil-controlling. It can still feel greasy in humidity or dry some skin out.

yes.title: Light, non-greasy on oily skin
yes.t: A light lotion that ==keeps oily skin hydrated and not slick==.

yes.title: Gentle on blemish-prone skin
yes.t: ==Often no breakouts on blemish-prone skin==, even long term.

no.title: Still greasy for some
no.t: ==Still left some oily faces greasy==, especially in humid weather.

no.title: Dries or stings a few
no.t: ==Left some faces tight, dry or stinging== after months of use.

la-roche-posay-toleriane-hydrating-gentl.bottom: A fragrance-free, non-foaming cream-gel cleanser that rinses clean with no film. It suits dry, sensitive and normal skin, and works as a gentle morning or second cleanse. It stings or breaks out a fair share of faces, so try it for a few days first.

yes.title: Cleans without stripping
yes.t: Rinses clean and ==leaves skin soft rather than tight==, a step up from foaming gels.

yes.title: Comfortable on dry, reactive skin
yes.t: ==Stays comfortable on dry, sensitive and barrier-stressed skin==, including skin on retinoids.

yes.title: Leaves no film behind
yes.t: Rinses off ==without the residue some creamy cleansers leave==, so skin feels bare and soft.

yes.title: One bottle lasts
yes.t: A ==large pump bottle lasts many months==, and it stays a daily staple for years.

no.title: Burns some faces
no.t: Stings or burns on some skin, ==often within the first days or around the eyes==.

no.title: Breaks some people out
no.t: Small bumps and milia show up ==within weeks on some faces==, while others stay clear.

no.title: Weak on makeup and sunscreen
no.t: On its own it ==struggles with waterproof makeup and mineral sunscreen==, so cleanse twice.

tip.t: Use an oil or balm first on makeup days, then this as the second cleanse.

no.title: Niacinamide can set it off
no.t: Skin that reacts to niacinamide ==often burns or flares== with this cleanser.

la-roche-posay-toleriane-purifying-foami.bottom: A fragrance-free ceramide gel cleanser for normal to oily skin that cleans without the squeaky feel. It dries some skin and breaks out or reddens a few.

yes.title: Gentle but thorough
yes.t: Cleans thoroughly ==without the squeaky, stripped feel== some foaming washes give.

yes.title: Tolerated by reactive skin
yes.t: Reactive, dehydrated skin often ==tolerates daily use==, even after other washes failed.

yes.title: Calmer-looking skin
yes.t: Redness and flakiness ==look calmer within weeks== of switching.

yes.title: Lasts a long time
yes.t: A large bottle at a modest price that ==lasts a long time==.

no.title: Drying for some
no.t: Face can ==feel tight and stripped right after washing==, which moisturizer fixes.

tip.t: Use it every other day and moisturize right after.

no.title: Breaks a few out
no.t: Breakouts ==got worse for a few==, even on skin that tolerated other washes.

no.title: Reddens some faces
no.t: A few faces ==turned red and warm at once==, or were left dry and stripped.

laneige-cream-skin-toner-moisturizer.bottom: A fragrance-free milky toner with ceramides that doubles as a light moisturizer. It suits dry, dehydrated and sensitive skin best; a few skins find it watery or break out.

yes.title: Deeply hydrating
yes.t: Skin looks ==plump, soft and glassy== after a few weeks of daily use.

yes.title: Kind to sensitive skin
yes.t: No acids or fragrance, and it ==calms skin that burned with other toners==.

yes.title: Soft glow under makeup
yes.t: Leaves ==a soft pearly glow== and a smooth base for makeup.

yes.title: Eases retinoid dryness
yes.t: Layered over a dry, retinoid-treated face, it ==softens the tight, flaky feeling==.

no.title: Does nothing for some
no.t: It can feel ==thin and watery, with no visible effect== beyond a brief refresh.

no.title: Closed bumps on some skin
no.t: ==Small closed bumps appeared== on a few clog-prone faces, more so with other oily layers.

alt.t: Byoma's milky toner, which some prefer to this one.

no.title: Needs cream on top in winter
no.t: Very dry skin ==may need a moisturizer layered over== it on cold, dry days.

tip.t: Layer a ceramide cream over it on very dry nights.

no.title: Slow to settle
no.t: Can feel ==tacky or slightly greasy for a few minutes==, more so on combination skin.

laneige-water-bank-blue-hyaluronic-cream.bottom: A scented hyaluronic gel-cream for normal to dry skin. Dry skin tends to drink it up, while oily and combination skin find it too light, and it's pricey.

yes.title: Hydrating on dry skin
yes.t: Dry skin ==drinks it up and glows without greasiness==, even on retinoids.

no.title: Fades on oilier skin
no.t: Oily and combination skin ==feel the hydration fade== in winter or after a few hours.

no.title: Pricey for the amount
no.t: ==The jar is small for the price==, so it runs out quickly.

laneige-water-sleeping-mask.bottom: A light overnight gel mask with hyaluronic acid and squalane that leaves skin plump and soft by morning. It suits normal, combination and mildly dry skin. It has added lavender and chamomile scent, and drier skin may want a cream over it.

yes.title: Plump, soft skin by morning
yes.t: A cool gel that ==leaves skin plump and soft by morning== without heaviness.

yes.title: Seals in what's under it
yes.t: ==Locks in the serums and moisturizer beneath it==, used as a last step.

yes.title: Dries down without a mess
yes.t: Absorbs ==without greasy transfer onto the pillow==, even on humid nights.

yes.title: Doubles as a day moisturizer
yes.t: Some wear it ==day and night in place of a light gel moisturizer==.

no.title: Added fragrance
no.t: Has lavender and chamomile scent, ==strong enough to put some off== and mild to others.

no.title: Thin on very dry skin
no.t: ==Light on seal-in power==, so dry skin often wants a cream on top.

tip.t: Layer it over moisturizer rather than using it alone.

no.title: Pricey for the results
no.t: ==High price for a small jar==, and a few see no difference from a plain gel moisturizer.

no.title: Breaks out a few faces
no.t: Frequent use brought ==small bumps or breakouts== on some skin.
